1module radae
2!------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3!
4! Description:
5!
6! Data and subroutines to calculate absorptivities and emissivity needed
7! for the LW radiation calculation.
8!
9! Public interfaces are:
10!
11! radae_init ------------ Initialization
12! initialize_radbuffer -- Initialize the 3D abs/emis arrays.
13! radabs ---------------- Compute absorptivities.
14! radems ---------------- Compute emissivity.
15! radtpl ---------------- Compute Temperatures and path lengths.
16! radoz2 ---------------- Compute ozone path lengths.
17! trcpth ---------------- Compute ghg path lengths.
18!
19! Author: B. Collins
20!
21! $Id$
22!------------------------------------------------------------------------------

93 (/1.09311e+02_r8,-1.46077e-01_r8/), &

100!

105!
106! Farwing correction constants for narrow-band emissivity model,
107! introduced to account for the deficiencies in narrow-band model
108! used to derive the emissivity; tuned with Arkings line-by-line
109! calculations. Just used for water vapor overlap with trace gases.
110!
111 real(r8):: fwcoef ! Farwing correction constant
112 real(r8):: fwc1,fwc2 ! Farwing correction constants
113 real(r8):: fc1 ! Farwing correction constant
114!
115! Collins/Hackney/Edwards (C/H/E) & Collins/Lee-Taylor/Edwards (C/LT/E)
116! H2O parameterization
117!
118! Notation:
119! U = integral (P/P_0 dW) eq. 15 in Ramanathan/Downey 1986
120! P = atmospheric pressure
121! P_0 = reference atmospheric pressure
122! W = precipitable water path
123! T_e = emission temperature
124! T_p = path temperature
125! RH = path relative humidity
126!
127! absorptivity/emissivity in window are fit using an expression:
128!
129! a/e = f_a/e * {1.0 - ln_a/e * cn_a/e}
130!
131! absorptivity/emissivity in non-window are fit using:
132!
133! a/e = f_a/e * a/e_norm
134!
135! where
136! a/e = absorptivity/emissivity
137! a/e_norm = absorptivity/emissivity normalized to 1
138! f_a/e = value of a/e as U->infinity = f(T_e) only
139! cn_a/e = continuum transmission
140! ln_a/e = line transmission
141!
142! spectral interval:
143! 1 = 0-800 cm^-1 and 1200-2200 cm^-1 (rotation and rotation-vibration)
144! 2 = 800-1200 cm^-1 (window)
145!
146 real(r8), parameter:: min_tp_h2o = 160.0_r8 ! min T_p for pre-calculated abs/emis
147 real(r8), parameter:: max_tp_h2o = 349.999999_r8 ! max T_p for pre-calculated abs/emis
148 integer, parameter :: ntemp = 192 ! Number of temperatures in H2O sat. table for Tp
149 integer, parameter :: o_fa = 6 ! Degree+1 of poly of T_e for absorptivity as U->inf.
150 integer, parameter :: o_fe = 6 ! Degree+1 of poly of T_e for emissivity as U->inf.
151!-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
152! Data for f in C/H/E fit -- value of A and E as U->infinity
153! New C/LT/E fit (Hitran 2K, CKD 2.4) -- no change
154! These values are determined by integrals of Planck functions or
155! derivatives of Planck functions only.
156!-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
157!
158! fa/fe coefficients for 2 bands (0-800 & 1200-2200, 800-1200 cm^-1)
159!
160! Coefficients of polynomial for f_a in T_e
161!
162 real(r8), parameter:: fat(o_fa,nbands) = reshape( (/ &
163 (/-1.06665373E-01_r8, 2.90617375E-02_r8, -2.70642049E-04_r8, & ! 0-800&1200-2200 cm^-1
164 1.07595511E-06_r8, -1.97419681E-09_r8, 1.37763374E-12_r8/), & ! 0-800&1200-2200 cm^-1
165 (/ 1.10666537E+00_r8, -2.90617375E-02_r8, 2.70642049E-04_r8, & ! 800-1200 cm^-1
166 -1.07595511E-06_r8, 1.97419681E-09_r8, -1.37763374E-12_r8/) /) & ! 800-1200 cm^-1
167 , (/o_fa,nbands/) )
168!
169! Coefficients of polynomial for f_e in T_e
170!
171 real(r8), parameter:: fet(o_fe,nbands) = reshape( (/ &
172 (/3.46148163E-01_r8, 1.51240299E-02_r8, -1.21846479E-04_r8, & ! 0-800&1200-2200 cm^-1
173 4.04970123E-07_r8, -6.15368936E-10_r8, 3.52415071E-13_r8/), & ! 0-800&1200-2200 cm^-1
174 (/6.53851837E-01_r8, -1.51240299E-02_r8, 1.21846479E-04_r8, & ! 800-1200 cm^-1
175 -4.04970123E-07_r8, 6.15368936E-10_r8, -3.52415071E-13_r8/) /) & ! 800-1200 cm^-1
176 , (/o_fa,nbands/) )
177!
178! Note: max values should be slightly underestimated to avoid index bound violations
179!
180 real(r8), parameter:: min_lp_h2o = -3.0_r8 ! min log_10(P) for pre-calculated abs/emis
181 real(r8), parameter:: min_p_h2o = 1.0e-3_r8 ! min log_10(P) for pre-calculated abs/emis
182 real(r8), parameter:: max_lp_h2o = -0.0000001_r8 ! max log_10(P) for pre-calculated abs/emis

185 real(r8), parameter:: dtp_h2o = 21.111111111111_r8 ! difference in adjacent elements of tp_h2o

201 real(r8), parameter :: g2(6)=(/14.4832_r8,4.30242_r8,5.23523_r8,3.25342_r8,0.698935_r8,16.5599_r8/)

205 real(r8), parameter :: bb(6)=(/-1.3512e-4_r8,-6.8320e-5_r8,-3.2609e-5_r8,-1.0228e-5_r8,-9.5743e-5_r8,-1.0304e-4_r8/)

215subroutine radabs(lchnk ,ncol , &
216 pbr ,pnm ,co2em ,co2eml ,tplnka , &
217 s2c ,tcg ,w ,h2otr ,plco2 , &
218 plh2o ,co2t ,tint ,tlayr ,plol , &
219 plos ,pmln ,piln ,ucfc11 ,ucfc12 , &
220 un2o0 ,un2o1 ,uch4 ,uco211 ,uco212 , &
221 uco213 ,uco221 ,uco222 ,uco223 ,uptype , &
222 bn2o0 ,bn2o1 ,bch4 ,abplnk1 ,abplnk2 , &
223 abstot ,absnxt ,plh2ob ,wb , &
224 odap_aer ,aer_trn_ttl, co2mmr)
225!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
226!
227! Purpose:
228! Compute absorptivities for h2o, co2, o3, ch4, n2o, cfc11 and cfc12
229!
230! Method:
231! h2o .... Uses nonisothermal emissivity method for water vapor from
232! Ramanathan, V. and P.Downey, 1986: A Nonisothermal
233! Emissivity and Absorptivity Formulation for Water Vapor
234! Journal of Geophysical Research, vol. 91., D8, pp 8649-8666
235!
236! Implementation updated by Collins, Hackney, and Edwards (2001)
237! using line-by-line calculations based upon Hitran 1996 and
238! CKD 2.1 for absorptivity and emissivity
239!
240! Implementation updated by Collins, Lee-Taylor, and Edwards (2003)
241! using line-by-line calculations based upon Hitran 2000 and
242! CKD 2.4 for absorptivity and emissivity
243!
244! co2 .... Uses absorptance parameterization of the 15 micro-meter
245! (500 - 800 cm-1) band system of Carbon Dioxide, from
246! Kiehl, J.T. and B.P.Briegleb, 1991: A New Parameterization
247! of the Absorptance Due to the 15 micro-meter Band System
248! of Carbon Dioxide Jouranl of Geophysical Research,
249! vol. 96., D5, pp 9013-9019.
250! Parameterizations for the 9.4 and 10.4 mircon bands of CO2
251! are also included.
252!
253! o3 .... Uses absorptance parameterization of the 9.6 micro-meter
254! band system of ozone, from Ramanathan, V. and R.Dickinson,
255! 1979: The Role of stratospheric ozone in the zonal and
256! seasonal radiative energy balance of the earth-troposphere
257! system. Journal of the Atmospheric Sciences, Vol. 36,
258! pp 1084-1104
259!
260! ch4 .... Uses a broad band model for the 7.7 micron band of methane.
261!
262! n20 .... Uses a broad band model for the 7.8, 8.6 and 17.0 micron
263! bands of nitrous oxide
264!
265! cfc11 ... Uses a quasi-linear model for the 9.2, 10.7, 11.8 and 12.5
266! micron bands of CFC11
267!
268! cfc12 ... Uses a quasi-linear model for the 8.6, 9.1, 10.8 and 11.2
269! micron bands of CFC12
270!
271!
272! Computes individual absorptivities for non-adjacent layers, accounting
273! for band overlap, and sums to obtain the total; then, computes the
274! nearest layer contribution.
275!
276! Author: W. Collins (H2O absorptivity) and J. Kiehl
277!------------------------------Arguments--------------------------------
278!
279! Input arguments
280!
281 integer, intent(in) :: lchnk ! chunk identifier
282 integer, intent(in) :: ncol ! number of atmospheric columns
283
284 real(r8), intent(in) :: pbr(pcols,pver) ! Prssr at mid-levels (dynes/cm2)
285 real(r8), intent(in) :: pnm(pcols,pverp) ! Prssr at interfaces (dynes/cm2)
286 real(r8), intent(in) :: co2em(pcols,pverp) ! Co2 emissivity function
287 real(r8), intent(in) :: co2eml(pcols,pver) ! Co2 emissivity function
288 real(r8), intent(in) :: tplnka(pcols,pverp) ! Planck fnctn level temperature
289 real(r8), intent(in) :: s2c(pcols,pverp) ! H2o continuum path length
290 real(r8), intent(in) :: tcg(pcols,pverp) ! H2o-mass-wgted temp. (Curtis-Godson approx.)
291 real(r8), intent(in) :: w(pcols,pverp) ! H2o prs wghted path
292 real(r8), intent(in) :: h2otr(pcols,pverp) ! H2o trnsmssn fnct for o3 overlap
293 real(r8), intent(in) :: plco2(pcols,pverp) ! Co2 prs wghted path length
294 real(r8), intent(in) :: plh2o(pcols,pverp) ! H2o prs wfhted path length
295 real(r8), intent(in) :: co2t(pcols,pverp) ! Tmp and prs wghted path length
296 real(r8), intent(in) :: tint(pcols,pverp) ! Interface temperatures
297 real(r8), intent(in) :: tlayr(pcols,pverp) ! K-1 level temperatures
298 real(r8), intent(in) :: plol(pcols,pverp) ! Ozone prs wghted path length
299 real(r8), intent(in) :: plos(pcols,pverp) ! Ozone path length
300 real(r8), intent(in) :: pmln(pcols,pver) ! Ln(pmidm1)
301 real(r8), intent(in) :: piln(pcols,pverp) ! Ln(pintm1)
302 real(r8), intent(in) :: plh2ob(nbands,pcols,pverp) ! Pressure weighted h2o path with
303 ! Hulst-Curtis-Godson temp. factor
304 ! for H2O bands
305 real(r8), intent(in) :: wb(nbands,pcols,pverp) ! H2o path length with
306 ! Hulst-Curtis-Godson temp. factor
307 ! for H2O bands
308
309! [fraction] absorbtion optical depth, cumulative from top
310 real(r8), intent(in) :: odap_aer(pcols,pver,nlwbands)
311
312! [fraction] Total transmission between interfaces k1 and k2
313 real(r8), intent(in) :: aer_trn_ttl(pcols,pverp,pverp,nlwbands)
314
315!
316! Trace gas variables
317!

319 real(r8), intent(in) :: ucfc11(pcols,pverp) ! CFC11 path length
320 real(r8), intent(in) :: ucfc12(pcols,pverp) ! CFC12 path length
321 real(r8), intent(in) :: un2o0(pcols,pverp) ! N2O path length
322 real(r8), intent(in) :: un2o1(pcols,pverp) ! N2O path length (hot band)
323 real(r8), intent(in) :: uch4(pcols,pverp) ! CH4 path length
324 real(r8), intent(in) :: uco211(pcols,pverp) ! CO2 9.4 micron band path length
325 real(r8), intent(in) :: uco212(pcols,pverp) ! CO2 9.4 micron band path length
326 real(r8), intent(in) :: uco213(pcols,pverp) ! CO2 9.4 micron band path length
327 real(r8), intent(in) :: uco221(pcols,pverp) ! CO2 10.4 micron band path length
328 real(r8), intent(in) :: uco222(pcols,pverp) ! CO2 10.4 micron band path length
329 real(r8), intent(in) :: uco223(pcols,pverp) ! CO2 10.4 micron band path length
330 real(r8), intent(in) :: uptype(pcols,pverp) ! continuum path length
331 real(r8), intent(in) :: bn2o0(pcols,pverp) ! pressure factor for n2o
332 real(r8), intent(in) :: bn2o1(pcols,pverp) ! pressure factor for n2o
333 real(r8), intent(in) :: bch4(pcols,pverp) ! pressure factor for ch4
334 real(r8), intent(in) :: abplnk1(14,pcols,pverp) ! non-nearest layer Planck factor
335 real(r8), intent(in) :: abplnk2(14,pcols,pverp) ! nearest layer factor
336!
337! Output arguments
338!
339 real(r8), intent(out) :: abstot(pcols,ntoplw:pverp,ntoplw:pverp) ! Total absorptivity
340 real(r8), intent(out) :: absnxt(pcols,pver,4) ! Total nearest layer absorptivity
341!

415 real(r8) fwk(pcols) ! Equation(33) in R&D far wing correction

422 real(r8) winpl(pcols,4) ! Nearest layer subdivision factor
423 real(r8) zinpl(pcols,4) ! Nearest layer subdivision factor

432 real(r8) ds2c ! Y in eq(7) in table A2 of R&D
433 real(r8) dplos ! Ozone pathlength eq(A2) in R&Di

436 real(r8) beta ! Ozone mean line parameter eq(A3) in R&Di

444 real(r8) u2 ! Effective ozone pathlength eq(A2) in R&Di
445 real(r8) rsqti ! Reciprocal of sqrt of path temperature

447 real(r8) tmp3 ! Weak band factor see K&B
448 real(r8) rdpnmsq ! Reciprocal of difference in press^2
449 real(r8) rdpnm ! Reciprocal of difference in press
450 real(r8) p1 ! Mean pressure factor
451 real(r8) p2 ! Mean pressure factor
452 real(r8) dtym10 ! T - 260 used in eq(9) and (10) table A3a
453 real(r8) dplco2 ! Co2 path length
454 real(r8) te ! A_0 T factor in ozone model table 1 of R&Di
455 real(r8) denom ! Denominator in eq(r8) of table A3a of R&D

461!
462 real(r8) trab2(pcols) ! H2o 500 - 800 cm-1
463 real(r8) absbnd ! Proportional to co2 band absorptance
464 real(r8) dbvtit(pcols,pverp)! Intrfc drvtv plnck fnctn for o3
465 real(r8) dbvtly(pcols,pver) ! Level drvtv plnck fnctn for o3
466!
467! Variables for Collins/Hackney/Edwards (C/H/E) &
468! Collins/Lee-Taylor/Edwards (C/LT/E) H2O parameterization
469
470!
471! Notation:
472! U = integral (P/P_0 dW) eq. 15 in Ramanathan/Downey 1986
473! P = atmospheric pressure
474! P_0 = reference atmospheric pressure
475! W = precipitable water path
476! T_e = emission temperature
477! T_p = path temperature
478! RH = path relative humidity
479!
480 real(r8) fa ! asymptotic value of abs. as U->infinity
481 real(r8) a_star ! normalized absorptivity for non-window
482 real(r8) l_star ! interpolated line transmission
483 real(r8) c_star ! interpolated continuum transmission
484
485 real(r8) te1 ! emission temperature
486 real(r8) te2 ! te^2
487 real(r8) te3 ! te^3
488 real(r8) te4 ! te^4
489 real(r8) te5 ! te^5
490
491 real(r8) log_u ! log base 10 of U
492 real(r8) log_uc ! log base 10 of H2O continuum path
493 real(r8) log_p ! log base 10 of P
494 real(r8) t_p ! T_p
495 real(r8) t_e ! T_e (offset by T_p)
496
497 integer iu ! index for log10(U)
498 integer iu1 ! iu + 1
499 integer iuc ! index for log10(H2O continuum path)
500 integer iuc1 ! iuc + 1

504 integer itp1 ! itp + 1

508 integer irh1 ! irh + 1
509
510 real(r8) dvar ! normalized variation in T_p/T_e/P/U
511 real(r8) uvar ! U * diffusivity factor
512 real(r8) uscl ! factor for lineary scaling as U->0
513
514 real(r8) wu ! weight for U
515 real(r8) wu1 ! 1 - wu
516 real(r8) wuc ! weight for H2O continuum path
517 real(r8) wuc1 ! 1 - wuc
518 real(r8) wp ! weight for P
519 real(r8) wp1 ! 1 - wp
520 real(r8) wtp ! weight for T_p
521 real(r8) wtp1 ! 1 - wtp
522 real(r8) wte ! weight for T_e
523 real(r8) wte1 ! 1 - wte
524 real(r8) wrh ! weight for RH
525 real(r8) wrh1 ! 1 - wrh
526
527 real(r8) w_0_0_ ! weight for Tp/Te combination
528 real(r8) w_0_1_ ! weight for Tp/Te combination
529 real(r8) w_1_0_ ! weight for Tp/Te combination
530 real(r8) w_1_1_ ! weight for Tp/Te combination
531
532 real(r8) w_0_00 ! weight for Tp/Te/RH combination
533 real(r8) w_0_01 ! weight for Tp/Te/RH combination
534 real(r8) w_0_10 ! weight for Tp/Te/RH combination
535 real(r8) w_0_11 ! weight for Tp/Te/RH combination
536 real(r8) w_1_00 ! weight for Tp/Te/RH combination
537 real(r8) w_1_01 ! weight for Tp/Te/RH combination
538 real(r8) w_1_10 ! weight for Tp/Te/RH combination
539 real(r8) w_1_11 ! weight for Tp/Te/RH combination
540
541 real(r8) w00_00 ! weight for P/Tp/Te/RH combination
542 real(r8) w00_01 ! weight for P/Tp/Te/RH combination
543 real(r8) w00_10 ! weight for P/Tp/Te/RH combination
544 real(r8) w00_11 ! weight for P/Tp/Te/RH combination
545 real(r8) w01_00 ! weight for P/Tp/Te/RH combination
546 real(r8) w01_01 ! weight for P/Tp/Te/RH combination
547 real(r8) w01_10 ! weight for P/Tp/Te/RH combination
548 real(r8) w01_11 ! weight for P/Tp/Te/RH combination
549 real(r8) w10_00 ! weight for P/Tp/Te/RH combination
550 real(r8) w10_01 ! weight for P/Tp/Te/RH combination
551 real(r8) w10_10 ! weight for P/Tp/Te/RH combination
552 real(r8) w10_11 ! weight for P/Tp/Te/RH combination
553 real(r8) w11_00 ! weight for P/Tp/Te/RH combination
554 real(r8) w11_01 ! weight for P/Tp/Te/RH combination
555 real(r8) w11_10 ! weight for P/Tp/Te/RH combination
556 real(r8) w11_11 ! weight for P/Tp/Te/RH combination
557
558 integer ib ! spectral interval:
559 ! 1 = 0-800 cm^-1 and 1200-2200 cm^-1
560 ! 2 = 800-1200 cm^-1
561
562
563 real(r8) pch2o ! H2O continuum path
564 real(r8) fch2o ! temp. factor for continuum
565 real(r8) uch2o ! U corresponding to H2O cont. path (window)
566
567 real(r8) fdif ! secant(zenith angle) for diffusivity approx.
568
569 real(r8) sslp_mks ! Sea-level pressure in MKS units
570 real(r8) esx ! saturation vapor pressure returned by qsat
571 real(r8) qsx ! saturation mixing ratio returned by qsat
572 real(r8) pnew_mks ! pnew in MKS units
573 real(r8) q_path ! effective specific humidity along path
574 real(r8) rh_path ! effective relative humidity along path
575
576 integer bnd_idx ! LW band index
577 real(r8) aer_pth_dlt ! [kg m-2] STRAER path between interface levels k1 and k2
578 real(r8) aer_pth_ngh(pcols)
579 ! [kg m-2] STRAER path between neighboring layers
580 real(r8) odap_aer_ttl ! [fraction] Total path absorption optical depth
581 real(r8) aer_trn_ngh(pcols,nlwbands)
582 ! [fraction] Total transmission between
583 ! nearest neighbor sub-levels
584!
585!--------------------------Statement function---------------------------
586!
587 real(r8) dbvt,t ! Planck fnctn tmp derivative for o3
588!
589 dbvt(t)=(-2.8911366682e-4_r8+(2.3771251896e-6_r8+1.1305188929e-10_r8*t)*t)/ &
590 (1.0_r8+(-6.1364820707e-3_r8+1.5550319767e-5_r8*t)*t)
591!
592!
593!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
594!
595! Initialize
596!
597 do k2=1,4
598 do k1=1,ntoplw-1
599 absnxt(:,k1,k2) = posinf ! set unused portions for lf95 restart write
600 end do
601 end do
602
603 do k=ntoplw,pverp
604 abstot(:,k,k) = posinf ! set unused portions for lf95 restart write
605 end do
606
607 do k=ntoplw,pver
608 do i=1,ncol
609 dbvtly(i,k) = dbvt(tlayr(i,k+1))
610 dbvtit(i,k) = dbvt(tint(i,k))
611 end do
612 end do
613 rmw = amd/amco2
614 do i=1,ncol
615 dbvtit(i,pverp) = dbvt(tint(i,pverp))
616 co2vmr(i) = co2mmr(i) * rmw
617 end do
618!
619 r293 = 1._r8/293._r8
620 r250 = 1._r8/250._r8
621 r3205 = 1._r8/.3205_r8
622 r300 = 1._r8/300._r8
623 rsslp = 1._r8/sslp
624 r2sslp = 1._r8/(2._r8*sslp)
625!
626!Constants for computing U corresponding to H2O cont. path
627!
628 fdif = 1.66_r8
629 sslp_mks = sslp / 10.0_r8
630!
631! Non-adjacent layer absorptivity:
632!
633! abso(i,1) 0 - 800 cm-1 h2o rotation band
634! abso(i,1) 1200 - 2200 cm-1 h2o vibration-rotation band
635! abso(i,2) 800 - 1200 cm-1 h2o window
636!
637! Separation between rotation and vibration-rotation dropped, so
638! only 2 slots needed for H2O absorptivity
639!
640! 500-800 cm^-1 H2o continuum/line overlap already included
641! in abso(i,1). This used to be in abso(i,4)
642!
643! abso(i,3) o3 9.6 micrometer band (nu3 and nu1 bands)
644! abso(i,4) co2 15 micrometer band system
645!
646 do k=ntoplw,pverp
647 do i=1,ncol
648 pnmsq(i,k) = pnm(i,k)**2
649 dtx(i) = tplnka(i,k) - 250._r8
650 end do
651 end do
652!
653! Non-nearest layer level loops
654!
655 do k1=pverp,ntoplw,-1
656 do k2=pverp,ntoplw,-1
657 if (k1 == k2) cycle
658 do i=1,ncol
659 dplh2o(i) = plh2o(i,k1) - plh2o(i,k2)
660 u(i) = abs(dplh2o(i))
661 sqrtu(i) = sqrt(u(i))
662 ds2c = abs(s2c(i,k1) - s2c(i,k2))
663 dw(i) = abs(w(i,k1) - w(i,k2))
664 uc1(i) = (ds2c + 1.7e-3_r8*u(i))*(1._r8 + 2._r8*ds2c)/(1._r8 + 15._r8*ds2c)
665 pch2o = ds2c
666 pnew(i) = u(i)/dw(i)
667 pnew_mks = pnew(i) * sslp_mks
668!
669! Changed effective path temperature to std. Curtis-Godson form
670!
671 tpatha = abs(tcg(i,k1) - tcg(i,k2))/dw(i)
672 t_p = min(max(tpatha, min_tp_h2o), max_tp_h2o)
673
674 call qsat_water(t_p, pnew_mks, esx, qsx)
675!
676! Compute effective RH along path
677!
678 q_path = dw(i) / abs(pnm(i,k1) - pnm(i,k2)) / rga
679!
680! Calculate effective u, pnew for each band using
681! Hulst-Curtis-Godson approximation:
682! Formulae: Goody and Yung, Atmospheric Radiation: Theoretical Basis,
683! 2nd edition, Oxford University Press, 1989.
684! Effective H2O path (w)
685! eq. 6.24, p. 228
686! Effective H2O path pressure (pnew = u/w):
687! eq. 6.29, p. 228
688!
689 ub(1) = abs(plh2ob(1,i,k1) - plh2ob(1,i,k2)) / psi(t_p,1)
690 ub(2) = abs(plh2ob(2,i,k1) - plh2ob(2,i,k2)) / psi(t_p,2)
691
692 pnewb(1) = ub(1) / abs(wb(1,i,k1) - wb(1,i,k2)) * phi(t_p,1)
693 pnewb(2) = ub(2) / abs(wb(2,i,k1) - wb(2,i,k2)) * phi(t_p,2)
694
695 dtx(i) = tplnka(i,k2) - 250._r8
696 dty(i) = tpatha - 250._r8
697
698 fwk(i) = fwcoef + fwc1/(1._r8 + fwc2*u(i))
699 fwku(i) = fwk(i)*u(i)
700!
701! Define variables for C/H/E (now C/LT/E) fit
702!
703! abso(i,1) 0 - 800 cm-1 h2o rotation band
704! abso(i,1) 1200 - 2200 cm-1 h2o vibration-rotation band
705! abso(i,2) 800 - 1200 cm-1 h2o window
706!
707! Separation between rotation and vibration-rotation dropped, so
708! only 2 slots needed for H2O absorptivity
709!
710! Notation:
711! U = integral (P/P_0 dW)
712! P = atmospheric pressure
713! P_0 = reference atmospheric pressure
714! W = precipitable water path
715! T_e = emission temperature
716! T_p = path temperature
717! RH = path relative humidity
718!
719!
720! Terms for asymptotic value of emissivity
721!
722 te1 = tplnka(i,k2)
723 te2 = te1 * te1
724 te3 = te2 * te1
725 te4 = te3 * te1
726 te5 = te4 * te1
727
728!
729! Band-independent indices for lines and continuum tables
730!
731 dvar = (t_p - min_tp_h2o) / dtp_h2o
732 itp = min(max(int(aint(dvar,r8)) + 1, 1), n_tp - 1)
733 itp1 = itp + 1
734 wtp = dvar - floor(dvar)
735 wtp1 = 1.0_r8 - wtp
736
737 t_e = min(max(tplnka(i,k2)-t_p, min_te_h2o), max_te_h2o)
738 dvar = (t_e - min_te_h2o) / dte_h2o
739 ite = min(max(int(aint(dvar,r8)) + 1, 1), n_te - 1)
740 ite1 = ite + 1
741 wte = dvar - floor(dvar)
742 wte1 = 1.0_r8 - wte
743
744 rh_path = min(max(q_path / qsx, min_rh_h2o), max_rh_h2o)
745 dvar = (rh_path - min_rh_h2o) / drh_h2o
746 irh = min(max(int(aint(dvar,r8)) + 1, 1), n_rh - 1)
747 irh1 = irh + 1
748 wrh = dvar - floor(dvar)
749 wrh1 = 1.0_r8 - wrh
750
751 w_0_0_ = wtp * wte
752 w_0_1_ = wtp * wte1
753 w_1_0_ = wtp1 * wte
754 w_1_1_ = wtp1 * wte1
755
756 w_0_00 = w_0_0_ * wrh
757 w_0_01 = w_0_0_ * wrh1
758 w_0_10 = w_0_1_ * wrh
759 w_0_11 = w_0_1_ * wrh1
760 w_1_00 = w_1_0_ * wrh
761 w_1_01 = w_1_0_ * wrh1
762 w_1_10 = w_1_1_ * wrh
763 w_1_11 = w_1_1_ * wrh1
764
765!
766! H2O Continuum path for 0-800 and 1200-2200 cm^-1
767!
768! Assume foreign continuum dominates total H2O continuum in these bands
769! per Clough et al, JGR, v. 97, no. D14 (Oct 20, 1992), p. 15776
770! Then the effective H2O path is just
771! U_c = integral[ f(P) dW ]
772! where
773! W = water-vapor mass and
774! f(P) = dependence of foreign continuum on pressure
775! = P / sslp
776! Then
777! U_c = U (the same effective H2O path as for lines)
778!
779!
780! Continuum terms for 800-1200 cm^-1
781!
782! Assume self continuum dominates total H2O continuum for this band
783! per Clough et al, JGR, v. 97, no. D14 (Oct 20, 1992), p. 15776
784! Then the effective H2O self-continuum path is
785! U_c = integral[ h(e,T) dW ] (*eq. 1*)
786! where
787! W = water-vapor mass and
788! e = partial pressure of H2O along path
789! T = temperature along path
790! h(e,T) = dependence of foreign continuum on e,T
791! = e / sslp * f(T)
792!
793! Replacing
794! e =~ q * P / epsilo
795! q = mixing ratio of H2O
796! epsilo = 0.622
797!
798! and using the definition
799! U = integral [ (P / sslp) dW ]
800! = (P / sslp) W (homogeneous path)
801!
802! the effective path length for the self continuum is
803! U_c = (q / epsilo) f(T) U (*eq. 2*)
804!
805! Once values of T, U, and q have been calculated for the inhomogeneous
806! path, this sets U_c for the corresponding
807! homogeneous atmosphere. However, this need not equal the
808! value of U_c' defined by eq. 1 for the actual inhomogeneous atmosphere
809! under consideration.
810!
811! Solution: hold T and q constant, solve for U' that gives U_c' by
812! inverting eq. (2):
813!
814! U' = (U_c * epsilo) / (q * f(T))
815!
816 fch2o = fh2oself(t_p)
817 uch2o = (pch2o * epsilo) / (q_path * fch2o)
818
819!
820! Band-dependent indices for non-window
821!
822 ib = 1
823
824 uvar = ub(ib) * fdif
825 log_u = min(log10(max(uvar, min_u_h2o)), max_lu_h2o)
826 dvar = (log_u - min_lu_h2o) / dlu_h2o
827 iu = min(max(int(aint(dvar,r8)) + 1, 1), n_u - 1)
828 iu1 = iu + 1
829 wu = dvar - floor(dvar)
830 wu1 = 1.0_r8 - wu
831
832 log_p = min(log10(max(pnewb(ib), min_p_h2o)), max_lp_h2o)
833 dvar = (log_p - min_lp_h2o) / dlp_h2o
834 ip = min(max(int(aint(dvar,r8)) + 1, 1), n_p - 1)
835 ip1 = ip + 1
836 wp = dvar - floor(dvar)
837 wp1 = 1.0_r8 - wp
838
839 w00_00 = wp * w_0_00
840 w00_01 = wp * w_0_01
841 w00_10 = wp * w_0_10
842 w00_11 = wp * w_0_11
843 w01_00 = wp * w_1_00
844 w01_01 = wp * w_1_01
845 w01_10 = wp * w_1_10
846 w01_11 = wp * w_1_11
847 w10_00 = wp1 * w_0_00
848 w10_01 = wp1 * w_0_01
849 w10_10 = wp1 * w_0_10
850 w10_11 = wp1 * w_0_11
851 w11_00 = wp1 * w_1_00
852 w11_01 = wp1 * w_1_01
853 w11_10 = wp1 * w_1_10
854 w11_11 = wp1 * w_1_11
855!
856! Asymptotic value of absorptivity as U->infinity
857!
858 fa = fat(1,ib) + &
859 fat(2,ib) * te1 + &
860 fat(3,ib) * te2 + &
861 fat(4,ib) * te3 + &
862 fat(5,ib) * te4 + &
863 fat(6,ib) * te5
864
865 a_star = &
866 ah2onw(ip , itp , iu , ite , irh ) * w11_11 * wu1 + &
867 ah2onw(ip , itp , iu , ite , irh1) * w11_10 * wu1 + &
868 ah2onw(ip , itp , iu , ite1, irh ) * w11_01 * wu1 + &
869 ah2onw(ip , itp , iu , ite1, irh1) * w11_00 * wu1 + &
870 ah2onw(ip , itp , iu1, ite , irh ) * w11_11 * wu + &
871 ah2onw(ip , itp , iu1, ite , irh1) * w11_10 * wu + &
872 ah2onw(ip , itp , iu1, ite1, irh ) * w11_01 * wu + &
873 ah2onw(ip , itp , iu1, ite1, irh1) * w11_00 * wu + &
874 ah2onw(ip , itp1, iu , ite , irh ) * w10_11 * wu1 + &
875 ah2onw(ip , itp1, iu , ite , irh1) * w10_10 * wu1 + &
876 ah2onw(ip , itp1, iu , ite1, irh ) * w10_01 * wu1 + &
877 ah2onw(ip , itp1, iu , ite1, irh1) * w10_00 * wu1 + &
878 ah2onw(ip , itp1, iu1, ite , irh ) * w10_11 * wu + &
879 ah2onw(ip , itp1, iu1, ite , irh1) * w10_10 * wu + &
880 ah2onw(ip , itp1, iu1, ite1, irh ) * w10_01 * wu + &
881 ah2onw(ip , itp1, iu1, ite1, irh1) * w10_00 * wu + &
882 ah2onw(ip1, itp , iu , ite , irh ) * w01_11 * wu1 + &
883 ah2onw(ip1, itp , iu , ite , irh1) * w01_10 * wu1 + &
884 ah2onw(ip1, itp , iu , ite1, irh ) * w01_01 * wu1 + &

1041!
1042! Line transmission in 800-1000 and 1000-1200 cm-1 intervals
1043!
1044 do i=1,ncol
1045 term7(i,1) = coefj(1,1) + coefj(2,1)*dty(i)*(1._r8 + c16*dty(i))
1046 term8(i,1) = coefk(1,1) + coefk(2,1)*dty(i)*(1._r8 + c17*dty(i))
1047 term7(i,2) = coefj(1,2) + coefj(2,2)*dty(i)*(1._r8 + c26*dty(i))
1048 term8(i,2) = coefk(1,2) + coefk(2,2)*dty(i)*(1._r8 + c27*dty(i))
1049 end do
1050!
1051! 500 - 800 cm-1 h2o rotation band overlap with co2
1052!
1053 do i=1,ncol
1054 k21 = term7(i,1) + term8(i,1)/ &
1055 (1._r8 + (c30 + c31*(dty(i)-10._r8)*(dty(i)-10._r8))*sqrtu(i))
1056 k22 = term7(i,2) + term8(i,2)/ &
1057 (1._r8 + (c28 + c29*(dty(i)-10._r8))*sqrtu(i))
1058 tr1 = exp(-(k21*(sqrtu(i) + fc1*fwku(i))))
1059 tr2 = exp(-(k22*(sqrtu(i) + fc1*fwku(i))))
1060 tr1=tr1*aer_trn_ttl(i,k1,k2,idx_LW_0650_0800)
1061! ! H2O line+STRAER trn 650--800 cm-1
1062 tr2=tr2*aer_trn_ttl(i,k1,k2,idx_LW_0500_0650)
1063! ! H2O line+STRAER trn 500--650 cm-1
1064 tr5 = exp(-((coefh(1,3) + coefh(2,3)*dtx(i))*uc1(i)))
1065 tr6 = exp(-((coefh(1,4) + coefh(2,4)*dtx(i))*uc1(i)))
1066 tr9(i) = tr1*tr5
1067 tr10(i) = tr2*tr6
1068 th2o(i) = tr10(i)
1069 trab2(i) = 0.65_r8*tr9(i) + 0.35_r8*tr10(i)
1070 end do
1071 if (k2 < k1) then
1072 do i=1,ncol
1073 to3h2o(i) = h2otr(i,k1)/h2otr(i,k2)
1074 end do
1075 else
1076 do i=1,ncol
1077 to3h2o(i) = h2otr(i,k2)/h2otr(i,k1)
1078 end do
1079 end if
1080!
1081! abso(i,3) o3 9.6 micrometer band (nu3 and nu1 bands)
1082!
1083 do i=1,ncol
1084 dpnm(i) = pnm(i,k1) - pnm(i,k2)
1085 to3co2(i) = (pnm(i,k1)*co2t(i,k1) - pnm(i,k2)*co2t(i,k2))/dpnm(i)
1086 te = (to3co2(i)*r293)**.7_r8

1088 if (dplos == 0._r8) then
1089 abso(i,3) = 0._r8
1090 to3(i) = 1._r8
1091 write(iulog,*) 'radiation ozone error ',k1,k2,plos(i,k1)
1092 else
1093 dplol = plol(i,k1) - plol(i,k2)
1094 u1 = 18.29_r8*abs(dplos)/te
1095 u2 = .5649_r8*abs(dplos)/te
1096 rphat = dplol/dplos
1097 tlocal = tint(i,k2)
1098 tcrfac = sqrt(tlocal*r250)*te
1099 beta = r3205*(rphat + dpfo3*tcrfac)
1100 realnu = te/beta
1101 tmp1 = u1/sqrt(4._r8 + u1*(1._r8 + realnu))
1102 tmp2 = u2/sqrt(4._r8 + u2*(1._r8 + realnu))
1103 o3bndi = 74._r8*te*log(1._r8 + tmp1 + tmp2)
1104 abso(i,3) = o3bndi*to3h2o(i)*dbvtit(i,k2)
1105 to3(i) = 1.0_r8/(1._r8 + 0.1_r8*tmp1 + 0.1_r8*tmp2)
1106 endif
1107 end do
1108!
1109! abso(i,4) co2 15 micrometer band system
1110!
1111 do i=1,ncol
1112 sqwp = sqrt(abs(plco2(i,k1) - plco2(i,k2)))
1113 et = exp(-480._r8/to3co2(i))
1114 sqti(i) = sqrt(to3co2(i))
1115 rsqti = 1._r8/sqti(i)
1116 et2 = et*et
1117 et4 = et2*et2
1118 omet = 1._r8 - 1.5_r8*et2
1119 f1co2 = 899.70_r8*omet*(1._r8 + 1.94774_r8*et + 4.73486_r8*et2)*rsqti
1120 f1sqwp(i) = f1co2*sqwp
1121 t1co2(i) = 1._r8/(1._r8 + (245.18_r8*omet*sqwp*rsqti))
1122 oneme = 1._r8 - et2
1123 alphat = oneme**3*rsqti
1124 pi = abs(dpnm(i))
1125 wco2 = 2.5221_r8*co2vmr(i)*pi*rga
1126 u7(i) = 4.9411e4_r8*alphat*et2*wco2
1127 u8 = 3.9744e4_r8*alphat*et4*wco2
1128 u9 = 1.0447e5_r8*alphat*et4*et2*wco2
1129 u13 = 2.8388e3_r8*alphat*et4*wco2
1130 tpath = to3co2(i)
1131 tlocal = tint(i,k2)
1132 tcrfac = sqrt(tlocal*r250*tpath*r300)
1133 posqt = ((pnm(i,k2) + pnm(i,k1))*r2sslp + dpfco2*tcrfac)*rsqti
1134 rbeta7(i) = 1._r8/(5.3228_r8*posqt)
1135 rbeta8 = 1._r8/(10.6576_r8*posqt)
1136 rbeta9 = rbeta7(i)
1137 rbeta13 = rbeta9
1138 f2co2(i) = (u7(i)/sqrt(4._r8 + u7(i)*(1._r8 + rbeta7(i)))) + &
1139 (u8 /sqrt(4._r8 + u8*(1._r8 + rbeta8))) + &
1140 (u9 /sqrt(4._r8 + u9*(1._r8 + rbeta9)))
1141 f3co2(i) = u13/sqrt(4._r8 + u13*(1._r8 + rbeta13))
1142 end do
1143 if (k2 >= k1) then
1144 do i=1,ncol
1145 sqti(i) = sqrt(tlayr(i,k2))
1146 end do
1147 end if
1148!
1149 do i=1,ncol
1150 tmp1 = log(1._r8 + f1sqwp(i))
1151 tmp2 = log(1._r8 + f2co2(i))
1152 tmp3 = log(1._r8 + f3co2(i))
1153 absbnd = (tmp1 + 2._r8*t1co2(i)*tmp2 + 2._r8*tmp3)*sqti(i)
1154 abso(i,4) = trab2(i)*co2em(i,k2)*absbnd
1155 tco2(i) = 1._r8/(1.0_r8+10.0_r8*(u7(i)/sqrt(4._r8 + u7(i)*(1._r8 + rbeta7(i)))))
1156 end do
1157!
1158! Calculate absorptivity due to trace gases, abstrc
1159!
1160 call trcab(ncol , &
1161 k1 ,k2 ,ucfc11 ,ucfc12 ,un2o0 , &
1162 un2o1 ,uch4 ,uco211 ,uco212 ,uco213 , &
1163 uco221 ,uco222 ,uco223 ,bn2o0 ,bn2o1 , &
1164 bch4 ,to3co2 ,pnm ,dw ,pnew , &
1165 s2c ,uptype ,u ,abplnk1 ,tco2 , &
1166 th2o ,to3 ,abstrc , &
1167 aer_trn_ttl)
1168!
1169! Sum total absorptivity
1170!
1171 do i=1,ncol

1173 abso(i,3) + abso(i,4) + abstrc(i)

1175 end do ! do k2 =
1176 end do ! do k1 =
1177!
1178! Adjacent layer absorptivity:
1179!
1180! abso(i,1) 0 - 800 cm-1 h2o rotation band
1181! abso(i,1) 1200 - 2200 cm-1 h2o vibration-rotation band
1182! abso(i,2) 800 - 1200 cm-1 h2o window
1183!
1184! Separation between rotation and vibration-rotation dropped, so
1185! only 2 slots needed for H2O absorptivity
1186!
1187! 500-800 cm^-1 H2o continuum/line overlap already included
1188! in abso(i,1). This used to be in abso(i,4)
1189!
1190! abso(i,3) o3 9.6 micrometer band (nu3 and nu1 bands)
1191! abso(i,4) co2 15 micrometer band system
1192!
1193! Nearest layer level loop
1194!
1195 do k2=pver,ntoplw,-1
1196 do i=1,ncol
1197 tbar(i,1) = 0.5_r8*(tint(i,k2+1) + tlayr(i,k2+1))
1198 emm(i,1) = 0.5_r8*(co2em(i,k2+1) + co2eml(i,k2))
1199 tbar(i,2) = 0.5_r8*(tlayr(i,k2+1) + tint(i,k2))
1200 emm(i,2) = 0.5_r8*(co2em(i,k2) + co2eml(i,k2))
1201 tbar(i,3) = 0.5_r8*(tbar(i,2) + tbar(i,1))
1202 emm(i,3) = emm(i,1)
1203 tbar(i,4) = tbar(i,3)
1204 emm(i,4) = emm(i,2)
1205 o3emm(i,1) = 0.5_r8*(dbvtit(i,k2+1) + dbvtly(i,k2))
1206 o3emm(i,2) = 0.5_r8*(dbvtit(i,k2) + dbvtly(i,k2))
1207 o3emm(i,3) = o3emm(i,1)
1208 o3emm(i,4) = o3emm(i,2)
1209 temh2o(i,1) = tbar(i,1)
1210 temh2o(i,2) = tbar(i,2)
1211 temh2o(i,3) = tbar(i,1)
1212 temh2o(i,4) = tbar(i,2)
1213 dpnm(i) = pnm(i,k2+1) - pnm(i,k2)
1214 end do
1215!
1216! Weighted Planck functions for trace gases
1217!
1218 do wvl = 1,14
1219 do i = 1,ncol
1220 bplnk(wvl,i,1) = 0.5_r8*(abplnk1(wvl,i,k2+1) + abplnk2(wvl,i,k2))
1221 bplnk(wvl,i,2) = 0.5_r8*(abplnk1(wvl,i,k2) + abplnk2(wvl,i,k2))
1222 bplnk(wvl,i,3) = bplnk(wvl,i,1)
1223 bplnk(wvl,i,4) = bplnk(wvl,i,2)
1224 end do
1225 end do
1226
1227 do i=1,ncol
1228 rdpnmsq = 1._r8/(pnmsq(i,k2+1) - pnmsq(i,k2))
1229 rdpnm = 1._r8/dpnm(i)
1230 p1 = .5_r8*(pbr(i,k2) + pnm(i,k2+1))
1231 p2 = .5_r8*(pbr(i,k2) + pnm(i,k2 ))
1232 uinpl(i,1) = (pnmsq(i,k2+1) - p1**2)*rdpnmsq
1233 uinpl(i,2) = -(pnmsq(i,k2 ) - p2**2)*rdpnmsq
1234 uinpl(i,3) = -(pnmsq(i,k2 ) - p1**2)*rdpnmsq
1235 uinpl(i,4) = (pnmsq(i,k2+1) - p2**2)*rdpnmsq
1236 winpl(i,1) = (.5_r8*( pnm(i,k2+1) - pbr(i,k2)))*rdpnm
1237 winpl(i,2) = (.5_r8*(-pnm(i,k2 ) + pbr(i,k2)))*rdpnm
1238 winpl(i,3) = (.5_r8*( pnm(i,k2+1) + pbr(i,k2)) - pnm(i,k2 ))*rdpnm
1239 winpl(i,4) = (.5_r8*(-pnm(i,k2 ) - pbr(i,k2)) + pnm(i,k2+1))*rdpnm
1240 tmp1 = 1._r8/(piln(i,k2+1) - piln(i,k2))
1241 tmp2 = piln(i,k2+1) - pmln(i,k2)
1242 tmp3 = piln(i,k2 ) - pmln(i,k2)
1243 zinpl(i,1) = (.5_r8*tmp2 )*tmp1
1244 zinpl(i,2) = ( - .5_r8*tmp3)*tmp1
1245 zinpl(i,3) = (.5_r8*tmp2 - tmp3)*tmp1
1246 zinpl(i,4) = ( tmp2 - .5_r8*tmp3)*tmp1
1247 pinpl(i,1) = 0.5_r8*(p1 + pnm(i,k2+1))
1248 pinpl(i,2) = 0.5_r8*(p2 + pnm(i,k2 ))
1249 pinpl(i,3) = 0.5_r8*(p1 + pnm(i,k2 ))
1250 pinpl(i,4) = 0.5_r8*(p2 + pnm(i,k2+1))
1251 end do
1252 do kn=1,4
1253 do i=1,ncol
1254 u(i) = uinpl(i,kn)*abs(plh2o(i,k2) - plh2o(i,k2+1))
1255 sqrtu(i) = sqrt(u(i))
1256 dw(i) = abs(w(i,k2) - w(i,k2+1))
1257 pnew(i) = u(i)/(winpl(i,kn)*dw(i))
1258 pnew_mks = pnew(i) * sslp_mks
1259 t_p = min(max(tbar(i,kn), min_tp_h2o), max_tp_h2o)
1260
1261 call qsat_water(t_p, pnew_mks, esx, qsx)
1262
1263 q_path = dw(i) / ABS(dpnm(i)) / rga
1264
1265 ds2c = abs(s2c(i,k2) - s2c(i,k2+1))
1266 uc1(i) = uinpl(i,kn)*ds2c
1267 pch2o = uc1(i)
1268 uc1(i) = (uc1(i) + 1.7e-3_r8*u(i))*(1._r8 + 2._r8*uc1(i))/(1._r8 + 15._r8*uc1(i))
1269 dtx(i) = temh2o(i,kn) - 250._r8
1270 dty(i) = tbar(i,kn) - 250._r8
1271
1272 fwk(i) = fwcoef + fwc1/(1._r8 + fwc2*u(i))
1273 fwku(i) = fwk(i)*u(i)
1274
1275 aer_trn_ngh(i, 1:nlwbands)= &
1276 exp(-fdif * uinpl(i,kn) * odap_aer(i, k2, 1:nlwbands ) )
1277
1278!
1279! Define variables for C/H/E (now C/LT/E) fit
1280!
1281! abso(i,1) 0 - 800 cm-1 h2o rotation band
1282! abso(i,1) 1200 - 2200 cm-1 h2o vibration-rotation band
1283! abso(i,2) 800 - 1200 cm-1 h2o window
1284!
1285! Separation between rotation and vibration-rotation dropped, so
1286! only 2 slots needed for H2O absorptivity
1287!
1288! Notation:
1289! U = integral (P/P_0 dW)
1290! P = atmospheric pressure
1291! P_0 = reference atmospheric pressure
1292! W = precipitable water path
1293! T_e = emission temperature
1294! T_p = path temperature
1295! RH = path relative humidity
1296!
1297!
1298! Terms for asymptotic value of emissivity
1299!
1300 te1 = temh2o(i,kn)
1301 te2 = te1 * te1
1302 te3 = te2 * te1
1303 te4 = te3 * te1
1304 te5 = te4 * te1
1305
1306!
1307! Indices for lines and continuum tables
1308! Note: because we are dealing with the nearest layer,
1309! the Hulst-Curtis-Godson corrections
1310! for inhomogeneous paths are not applied.
1311!
1312 uvar = u(i)*fdif
1313 log_u = min(log10(max(uvar, min_u_h2o)), max_lu_h2o)
1314 dvar = (log_u - min_lu_h2o) / dlu_h2o
1315 iu = min(max(int(aint(dvar,r8)) + 1, 1), n_u - 1)
1316 iu1 = iu + 1
1317 wu = dvar - floor(dvar)
1318 wu1 = 1.0_r8 - wu
1319
1320 log_p = min(log10(max(pnew(i), min_p_h2o)), max_lp_h2o)
1321 dvar = (log_p - min_lp_h2o) / dlp_h2o
1322 ip = min(max(int(aint(dvar,r8)) + 1, 1), n_p - 1)
1323 ip1 = ip + 1
1324 wp = dvar - floor(dvar)
1325 wp1 = 1.0_r8 - wp
1326
1327 dvar = (t_p - min_tp_h2o) / dtp_h2o
1328 itp = min(max(int(aint(dvar,r8)) + 1, 1), n_tp - 1)
1329 itp1 = itp + 1
1330 wtp = dvar - floor(dvar)
1331 wtp1 = 1.0_r8 - wtp
1332
1333 t_e = min(max(temh2o(i,kn)-t_p,min_te_h2o),max_te_h2o)
1334 dvar = (t_e - min_te_h2o) / dte_h2o
1335 ite = min(max(int(aint(dvar,r8)) + 1, 1), n_te - 1)
1336 ite1 = ite + 1
1337 wte = dvar - floor(dvar)
1338 wte1 = 1.0_r8 - wte
1339
1340 rh_path = min(max(q_path / qsx, min_rh_h2o), max_rh_h2o)
1341 dvar = (rh_path - min_rh_h2o) / drh_h2o
1342 irh = min(max(int(aint(dvar,r8)) + 1, 1), n_rh - 1)
1343 irh1 = irh + 1
1344 wrh = dvar - floor(dvar)
1345 wrh1 = 1.0_r8 - wrh
1346
1347 w_0_0_ = wtp * wte
1348 w_0_1_ = wtp * wte1
1349 w_1_0_ = wtp1 * wte
1350 w_1_1_ = wtp1 * wte1
1351
1352 w_0_00 = w_0_0_ * wrh
1353 w_0_01 = w_0_0_ * wrh1
1354 w_0_10 = w_0_1_ * wrh
1355 w_0_11 = w_0_1_ * wrh1
1356 w_1_00 = w_1_0_ * wrh
1357 w_1_01 = w_1_0_ * wrh1
1358 w_1_10 = w_1_1_ * wrh
1359 w_1_11 = w_1_1_ * wrh1
1360
1361 w00_00 = wp * w_0_00
1362 w00_01 = wp * w_0_01
1363 w00_10 = wp * w_0_10
1364 w00_11 = wp * w_0_11
1365 w01_00 = wp * w_1_00
1366 w01_01 = wp * w_1_01
1367 w01_10 = wp * w_1_10
1368 w01_11 = wp * w_1_11
1369 w10_00 = wp1 * w_0_00
1370 w10_01 = wp1 * w_0_01
1371 w10_10 = wp1 * w_0_10
1372 w10_11 = wp1 * w_0_11
1373 w11_00 = wp1 * w_1_00
1374 w11_01 = wp1 * w_1_01
1375 w11_10 = wp1 * w_1_10
1376 w11_11 = wp1 * w_1_11
1377
1378!
1379! Non-window absorptivity
1380!
1381 ib = 1
1382
1383 fa = fat(1,ib) + &
1384 fat(2,ib) * te1 + &
1385 fat(3,ib) * te2 + &
1386 fat(4,ib) * te3 + &
1387 fat(5,ib) * te4 + &
1388 fat(6,ib) * te5
1389
1390 a_star = &
1391 ah2onw(ip , itp , iu , ite , irh ) * w11_11 * wu1 + &
1392 ah2onw(ip , itp , iu , ite , irh1) * w11_10 * wu1 + &
1393 ah2onw(ip , itp , iu , ite1, irh ) * w11_01 * wu1 + &
1394 ah2onw(ip , itp , iu , ite1, irh1) * w11_00 * wu1 + &
1395 ah2onw(ip , itp , iu1, ite , irh ) * w11_11 * wu + &
1396 ah2onw(ip , itp , iu1, ite , irh1) * w11_10 * wu + &
1397 ah2onw(ip , itp , iu1, ite1, irh ) * w11_01 * wu + &
1398 ah2onw(ip , itp , iu1, ite1, irh1) * w11_00 * wu + &
1399 ah2onw(ip , itp1, iu , ite , irh ) * w10_11 * wu1 + &
1400 ah2onw(ip , itp1, iu , ite , irh1) * w10_10 * wu1 + &
1401 ah2onw(ip , itp1, iu , ite1, irh ) * w10_01 * wu1 + &
1402 ah2onw(ip , itp1, iu , ite1, irh1) * w10_00 * wu1 + &
1403 ah2onw(ip , itp1, iu1, ite , irh ) * w10_11 * wu + &
1404 ah2onw(ip , itp1, iu1, ite , irh1) * w10_10 * wu + &
1405 ah2onw(ip , itp1, iu1, ite1, irh ) * w10_01 * wu + &
1406 ah2onw(ip , itp1, iu1, ite1, irh1) * w10_00 * wu + &
1407 ah2onw(ip1, itp , iu , ite , irh ) * w01_11 * wu1 + &
1408 ah2onw(ip1, itp , iu , ite , irh1) * w01_10 * wu1 + &
1409 ah2onw(ip1, itp , iu , ite1, irh ) * w01_01 * wu1 + &
1410 ah2onw(ip1, itp , iu , ite1, irh1) * w01_00 * wu1 + &
1411 ah2onw(ip1, itp , iu1, ite , irh ) * w01_11 * wu + &
1412 ah2onw(ip1, itp , iu1, ite , irh1) * w01_10 * wu + &
1413 ah2onw(ip1, itp , iu1, ite1, irh ) * w01_01 * wu + &
1414 ah2onw(ip1, itp , iu1, ite1, irh1) * w01_00 * wu + &
1415 ah2onw(ip1, itp1, iu , ite , irh ) * w00_11 * wu1 + &
1416 ah2onw(ip1, itp1, iu , ite , irh1) * w00_10 * wu1 + &
1417 ah2onw(ip1, itp1, iu , ite1, irh ) * w00_01 * wu1 + &
1418 ah2onw(ip1, itp1, iu , ite1, irh1) * w00_00 * wu1 + &
1419 ah2onw(ip1, itp1, iu1, ite , irh ) * w00_11 * wu + &
1420 ah2onw(ip1, itp1, iu1, ite , irh1) * w00_10 * wu + &
1421 ah2onw(ip1, itp1, iu1, ite1, irh ) * w00_01 * wu + &
1422 ah2onw(ip1, itp1, iu1, ite1, irh1) * w00_00 * wu
1423
1424 abso(i,ib) = min(max(fa * (1.0_r8 - (1.0_r8 - a_star) * &
1425 aer_trn_ngh(i,ib)), &
1426 0.0_r8), 1.0_r8)
1427
1428!
1429! Invoke linear limit for scaling wrt u below min_u_h2o
1430!
1431 if (uvar < min_u_h2o) then
1432 uscl = uvar / min_u_h2o
1433 abso(i,ib) = abso(i,ib) * uscl
1434 endif
1435
1436!
1437! Window absorptivity
1438!
1439 ib = 2
1440
1441 fa = fat(1,ib) + &
1442 fat(2,ib) * te1 + &
1443 fat(3,ib) * te2 + &
1444 fat(4,ib) * te3 + &
1445 fat(5,ib) * te4 + &
1446 fat(6,ib) * te5
1447
1448 a_star = &
1449 ah2ow(ip , itp , iu , ite , irh ) * w11_11 * wu1 + &
1450 ah2ow(ip , itp , iu , ite , irh1) * w11_10 * wu1 + &
1451 ah2ow(ip , itp , iu , ite1, irh ) * w11_01 * wu1 + &
1452 ah2ow(ip , itp , iu , ite1, irh1) * w11_00 * wu1 + &
1453 ah2ow(ip , itp , iu1, ite , irh ) * w11_11 * wu + &
1454 ah2ow(ip , itp , iu1, ite , irh1) * w11_10 * wu + &
1455 ah2ow(ip , itp , iu1, ite1, irh ) * w11_01 * wu + &
1456 ah2ow(ip , itp , iu1, ite1, irh1) * w11_00 * wu + &
1457 ah2ow(ip , itp1, iu , ite , irh ) * w10_11 * wu1 + &
1458 ah2ow(ip , itp1, iu , ite , irh1) * w10_10 * wu1 + &
1459 ah2ow(ip , itp1, iu , ite1, irh ) * w10_01 * wu1 + &
1460 ah2ow(ip , itp1, iu , ite1, irh1) * w10_00 * wu1 + &
1461 ah2ow(ip , itp1, iu1, ite , irh ) * w10_11 * wu + &
1462 ah2ow(ip , itp1, iu1, ite , irh1) * w10_10 * wu + &
1463 ah2ow(ip , itp1, iu1, ite1, irh ) * w10_01 * wu + &
1464 ah2ow(ip , itp1, iu1, ite1, irh1) * w10_00 * wu + &
1465 ah2ow(ip1, itp , iu , ite , irh ) * w01_11 * wu1 + &
1466 ah2ow(ip1, itp , iu , ite , irh1) * w01_10 * wu1 + &
1467 ah2ow(ip1, itp , iu , ite1, irh ) * w01_01 * wu1 + &
1468 ah2ow(ip1, itp , iu , ite1, irh1) * w01_00 * wu1 + &
1469 ah2ow(ip1, itp , iu1, ite , irh ) * w01_11 * wu + &
1470 ah2ow(ip1, itp , iu1, ite , irh1) * w01_10 * wu + &
1471 ah2ow(ip1, itp , iu1, ite1, irh ) * w01_01 * wu + &
1472 ah2ow(ip1, itp , iu1, ite1, irh1) * w01_00 * wu + &
1473 ah2ow(ip1, itp1, iu , ite , irh ) * w00_11 * wu1 + &
1474 ah2ow(ip1, itp1, iu , ite , irh1) * w00_10 * wu1 + &
1475 ah2ow(ip1, itp1, iu , ite1, irh ) * w00_01 * wu1 + &
1476 ah2ow(ip1, itp1, iu , ite1, irh1) * w00_00 * wu1 + &
1477 ah2ow(ip1, itp1, iu1, ite , irh ) * w00_11 * wu + &
1478 ah2ow(ip1, itp1, iu1, ite , irh1) * w00_10 * wu + &
1479 ah2ow(ip1, itp1, iu1, ite1, irh ) * w00_01 * wu + &
1480 ah2ow(ip1, itp1, iu1, ite1, irh1) * w00_00 * wu
1481
1482 abso(i,ib) = min(max(fa * (1.0_r8 - (1.0_r8 - a_star) * &
1483 aer_trn_ngh(i,ib)), &
1484 0.0_r8), 1.0_r8)
1485
1486!
1487! Invoke linear limit for scaling wrt u below min_u_h2o
1488!
1489 if (uvar < min_u_h2o) then
1490 uscl = uvar / min_u_h2o
1491 abso(i,ib) = abso(i,ib) * uscl
1492 endif
1493
1494 end do
1495!
1496! Line transmission in 800-1000 and 1000-1200 cm-1 intervals
1497!
1498 do i=1,ncol
1499 term7(i,1) = coefj(1,1) + coefj(2,1)*dty(i)*(1._r8 + c16*dty(i))
1500 term8(i,1) = coefk(1,1) + coefk(2,1)*dty(i)*(1._r8 + c17*dty(i))
1501 term7(i,2) = coefj(1,2) + coefj(2,2)*dty(i)*(1._r8 + c26*dty(i))
1502 term8(i,2) = coefk(1,2) + coefk(2,2)*dty(i)*(1._r8 + c27*dty(i))
1503 end do
1504!
1505! 500 - 800 cm-1 h2o rotation band overlap with co2
1506!
1507 do i=1,ncol
1508 dtym10 = dty(i) - 10._r8
1509 denom = 1._r8 + (c30 + c31*dtym10*dtym10)*sqrtu(i)
1510 k21 = term7(i,1) + term8(i,1)/denom
1511 denom = 1._r8 + (c28 + c29*dtym10 )*sqrtu(i)
1512 k22 = term7(i,2) + term8(i,2)/denom
1513 tr1 = exp(-(k21*(sqrtu(i) + fc1*fwku(i))))
1514 tr2 = exp(-(k22*(sqrtu(i) + fc1*fwku(i))))
1515 tr1=tr1*aer_trn_ngh(i,idx_LW_0650_0800)
1516! ! H2O line+STRAER trn 650--800 cm-1
1517 tr2=tr2*aer_trn_ngh(i,idx_LW_0500_0650)
1518! ! H2O line+STRAER trn 500--650 cm-1
1519 tr5 = exp(-((coefh(1,3) + coefh(2,3)*dtx(i))*uc1(i)))
1520 tr6 = exp(-((coefh(1,4) + coefh(2,4)*dtx(i))*uc1(i)))
1521 tr9(i) = tr1*tr5
1522 tr10(i) = tr2*tr6
1523 trab2(i)= 0.65_r8*tr9(i) + 0.35_r8*tr10(i)
1524 th2o(i) = tr10(i)
1525 end do
1526!
1527! abso(i,3) o3 9.6 micrometer (nu3 and nu1 bands)
1528!
1529 do i=1,ncol
1530 te = (tbar(i,kn)*r293)**.7_r8
1531 dplos = abs(plos(i,k2+1) - plos(i,k2))
1532 u1 = zinpl(i,kn)*18.29_r8*dplos/te
1533 u2 = zinpl(i,kn)*.5649_r8*dplos/te
1534 tlocal = tbar(i,kn)
1535 tcrfac = sqrt(tlocal*r250)*te
1536 beta = r3205*(pinpl(i,kn)*rsslp + dpfo3*tcrfac)
1537 realnu = te/beta
1538 tmp1 = u1/sqrt(4._r8 + u1*(1._r8 + realnu))
1539 tmp2 = u2/sqrt(4._r8 + u2*(1._r8 + realnu))
1540 o3bndi = 74._r8*te*log(1._r8 + tmp1 + tmp2)
1541 abso(i,3) = o3bndi*o3emm(i,kn)*(h2otr(i,k2+1)/h2otr(i,k2))
1542 to3(i) = 1.0_r8/(1._r8 + 0.1_r8*tmp1 + 0.1_r8*tmp2)
1543 end do
1544!
1545! abso(i,4) co2 15 micrometer band system
1546!
1547 do i=1,ncol
1548 dplco2 = plco2(i,k2+1) - plco2(i,k2)
1549 sqwp = sqrt(uinpl(i,kn)*dplco2)
1550 et = exp(-480._r8/tbar(i,kn))
1551 sqti(i) = sqrt(tbar(i,kn))
1552 rsqti = 1._r8/sqti(i)
1553 et2 = et*et
1554 et4 = et2*et2
1555 omet = (1._r8 - 1.5_r8*et2)
1556 f1co2 = 899.70_r8*omet*(1._r8 + 1.94774_r8*et + 4.73486_r8*et2)*rsqti
1557 f1sqwp(i)= f1co2*sqwp
1558 t1co2(i) = 1._r8/(1._r8 + (245.18_r8*omet*sqwp*rsqti))
1559 oneme = 1._r8 - et2
1560 alphat = oneme**3*rsqti
1561 pi = abs(dpnm(i))*winpl(i,kn)
1562 wco2 = 2.5221_r8*co2vmr(i)*pi*rga
1563 u7(i) = 4.9411e4_r8*alphat*et2*wco2
1564 u8 = 3.9744e4_r8*alphat*et4*wco2
1565 u9 = 1.0447e5_r8*alphat*et4*et2*wco2
1566 u13 = 2.8388e3_r8*alphat*et4*wco2
1567 tpath = tbar(i,kn)
1568 tlocal = tbar(i,kn)
1569 tcrfac = sqrt((tlocal*r250)*(tpath*r300))
1570 posqt = (pinpl(i,kn)*rsslp + dpfco2*tcrfac)*rsqti
1571 rbeta7(i)= 1._r8/(5.3228_r8*posqt)
1572 rbeta8 = 1._r8/(10.6576_r8*posqt)
1573 rbeta9 = rbeta7(i)
1574 rbeta13 = rbeta9
1575 f2co2(i) = u7(i)/sqrt(4._r8 + u7(i)*(1._r8 + rbeta7(i))) + &
1576 u8 /sqrt(4._r8 + u8*(1._r8 + rbeta8)) + &
1577 u9 /sqrt(4._r8 + u9*(1._r8 + rbeta9))
1578 f3co2(i) = u13/sqrt(4._r8 + u13*(1._r8 + rbeta13))
1579 tmp1 = log(1._r8 + f1sqwp(i))
1580 tmp2 = log(1._r8 + f2co2(i))
1581 tmp3 = log(1._r8 + f3co2(i))
1582 absbnd = (tmp1 + 2._r8*t1co2(i)*tmp2 + 2._r8*tmp3)*sqti(i)
1583 abso(i,4)= trab2(i)*emm(i,kn)*absbnd
1584 tco2(i) = 1.0_r8/(1.0_r8+ 10.0_r8*u7(i)/sqrt(4._r8 + u7(i)*(1._r8 + rbeta7(i))))
1585 end do ! do i =
1586!
1587! Calculate trace gas absorptivity for nearest layer, abstrc
1588!
1589 call trcabn(ncol , &
1590 k2 ,kn ,ucfc11 ,ucfc12 ,un2o0 , &
1591 un2o1 ,uch4 ,uco211 ,uco212 ,uco213 , &
1592 uco221 ,uco222 ,uco223 ,tbar ,bplnk , &
1593 winpl ,pinpl ,tco2 ,th2o ,to3 , &
1594 uptype ,dw ,s2c ,u ,pnew , &
1595 abstrc ,uinpl , &
1596 aer_trn_ngh)
1597!
1598! Total next layer absorptivity:
1599!
1600 do i=1,ncol
1601 absnxt(i,k2,kn) = abso(i,1) + abso(i,2) + &
1602 abso(i,3) + abso(i,4) + abstrc(i)
1603 end do
1604 end do ! do kn =
1605 end do ! do k2 =
1606
1607 return
1608end subroutine radabs
1609
1610!====================================================================================
1611
1612subroutine radems(lchnk ,ncol , &
1613 s2c ,tcg ,w ,tplnke ,plh2o , &
1614 pnm ,plco2 ,tint ,tint4 ,tlayr , &
1615 tlayr4 ,plol ,plos ,ucfc11 ,ucfc12 , &
1616 un2o0 ,un2o1 ,uch4 ,uco211 ,uco212 , &
1617 uco213 ,uco221 ,uco222 ,uco223 ,uptype , &
1618 bn2o0 ,bn2o1 ,bch4 ,co2em ,co2eml , &
1619 co2t ,h2otr ,abplnk1 ,abplnk2 ,emstot , &
1620 plh2ob ,wb , &
1621 aer_trn_ttl, co2mmr)
1622!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
1623!
1624! Purpose:
1625! Compute emissivity for H2O, CO2, O3, CH4, N2O, CFC11 and CFC12
1626!
1627! Method:
1628! H2O .... Uses nonisothermal emissivity method for water vapor from
1629! Ramanathan, V. and P.Downey, 1986: A Nonisothermal
1630! Emissivity and Absorptivity Formulation for Water Vapor
1631! Jouranl of Geophysical Research, vol. 91., D8, pp 8649-8666
1632!
1633! Implementation updated by Collins,Hackney, and Edwards 2001
1634! using line-by-line calculations based upon Hitran 1996 and
1635! CKD 2.1 for absorptivity and emissivity
1636!
1637! Implementation updated by Collins, Lee-Taylor, and Edwards (2003)
1638! using line-by-line calculations based upon Hitran 2000 and
1639! CKD 2.4 for absorptivity and emissivity
1640!
1641! CO2 .... Uses absorptance parameterization of the 15 micro-meter
1642! (500 - 800 cm-1) band system of Carbon Dioxide, from
1643! Kiehl, J.T. and B.P.Briegleb, 1991: A New Parameterization
1644! of the Absorptance Due to the 15 micro-meter Band System
1645! of Carbon Dioxide Jouranl of Geophysical Research,
1646! vol. 96., D5, pp 9013-9019. Also includes the effects
1647! of the 9.4 and 10.4 micron bands of CO2.
1648!
1649! O3 .... Uses absorptance parameterization of the 9.6 micro-meter
1650! band system of ozone, from Ramanathan, V. and R. Dickinson,
1651! 1979: The Role of stratospheric ozone in the zonal and
1652! seasonal radiative energy balance of the earth-troposphere
1653! system. Journal of the Atmospheric Sciences, Vol. 36,
1654! pp 1084-1104
1655!
1656! ch4 .... Uses a broad band model for the 7.7 micron band of methane.
1657!
1658! n20 .... Uses a broad band model for the 7.8, 8.6 and 17.0 micron
1659! bands of nitrous oxide
1660!
1661! cfc11 ... Uses a quasi-linear model for the 9.2, 10.7, 11.8 and 12.5
1662! micron bands of CFC11
1663!
1664! cfc12 ... Uses a quasi-linear model for the 8.6, 9.1, 10.8 and 11.2
1665! micron bands of CFC12
1666!
1667!
1668! Computes individual emissivities, accounting for band overlap, and
1669! sums to obtain the total.
1670!
1671! Author: W. Collins (H2O emissivity) and J. Kiehl
1672!------------------------------Arguments--------------------------------
1673!
1674! Input arguments
1675!
1676 integer, intent(in) :: lchnk ! chunk identifier
1677 integer, intent(in) :: ncol ! number of atmospheric columns
1678
1679 real(r8), intent(in) :: s2c(pcols,pverp) ! H2o continuum path length
1680 real(r8), intent(in) :: tcg(pcols,pverp) ! H2o-mass-wgted temp. (Curtis-Godson approx.)
1681 real(r8), intent(in) :: w(pcols,pverp) ! H2o path length
1682 real(r8), intent(in) :: tplnke(pcols) ! Layer planck temperature
1683 real(r8), intent(in) :: plh2o(pcols,pverp) ! H2o prs wghted path length
1684 real(r8), intent(in) :: pnm(pcols,pverp) ! Model interface pressure
1685 real(r8), intent(in) :: plco2(pcols,pverp) ! Prs wghted path of co2
1686 real(r8), intent(in) :: tint(pcols,pverp) ! Model interface temperatures
1687 real(r8), intent(in) :: tint4(pcols,pverp) ! Tint to the 4th power
1688 real(r8), intent(in) :: tlayr(pcols,pverp) ! K-1 model layer temperature
1689 real(r8), intent(in) :: tlayr4(pcols,pverp) ! Tlayr to the 4th power
1690 real(r8), intent(in) :: plol(pcols,pverp) ! Pressure wghtd ozone path
1691 real(r8), intent(in) :: plos(pcols,pverp) ! Ozone path
1692 real(r8), intent(in) :: plh2ob(nbands,pcols,pverp) ! Pressure weighted h2o path with
1693 ! Hulst-Curtis-Godson temp. factor
1694 ! for H2O bands
1695 real(r8), intent(in) :: wb(nbands,pcols,pverp) ! H2o path length with
1696 ! Hulst-Curtis-Godson temp. factor
1697 ! for H2O bands
1698
1699 real(r8), intent(in) :: aer_trn_ttl(pcols,pverp,pverp,nlwbands)
1700! ! [fraction] Total strat. aerosol
1701! ! transmission between interfaces k1 and k2
1702
1703!
1704! Trace gas variables
1705!
1706 real(r8), intent(in) :: co2mmr(pcols) ! co2 column mean mass mixing ratio
1707 real(r8), intent(in) :: ucfc11(pcols,pverp) ! CFC11 path length
1708 real(r8), intent(in) :: ucfc12(pcols,pverp) ! CFC12 path length
1709 real(r8), intent(in) :: un2o0(pcols,pverp) ! N2O path length
1710 real(r8), intent(in) :: un2o1(pcols,pverp) ! N2O path length (hot band)
1711 real(r8), intent(in) :: uch4(pcols,pverp) ! CH4 path length
1712 real(r8), intent(in) :: uco211(pcols,pverp) ! CO2 9.4 micron band path length
1713 real(r8), intent(in) :: uco212(pcols,pverp) ! CO2 9.4 micron band path length
1714 real(r8), intent(in) :: uco213(pcols,pverp) ! CO2 9.4 micron band path length
1715 real(r8), intent(in) :: uco221(pcols,pverp) ! CO2 10.4 micron band path length
1716 real(r8), intent(in) :: uco222(pcols,pverp) ! CO2 10.4 micron band path length
1717 real(r8), intent(in) :: uco223(pcols,pverp) ! CO2 10.4 micron band path length
1718 real(r8), intent(in) :: bn2o0(pcols,pverp) ! pressure factor for n2o
1719 real(r8), intent(in) :: bn2o1(pcols,pverp) ! pressure factor for n2o
1720 real(r8), intent(in) :: bch4(pcols,pverp) ! pressure factor for ch4
1721 real(r8), intent(in) :: uptype(pcols,pverp) ! p-type continuum path length
1722!
1723! Output arguments
1724!
1725 real(r8), intent(out) :: emstot(pcols,pverp) ! Total emissivity
1726 real(r8), intent(out) :: co2em(pcols,pverp) ! Layer co2 normalzd plnck funct drvtv
1727 real(r8), intent(out) :: co2eml(pcols,pver) ! Intrfc co2 normalzd plnck func drvtv
1728 real(r8), intent(out) :: co2t(pcols,pverp) ! Tmp and prs weighted path length
1729 real(r8), intent(out) :: h2otr(pcols,pverp) ! H2o transmission over o3 band
1730 real(r8), intent(out) :: abplnk1(14,pcols,pverp) ! non-nearest layer Plack factor
1731 real(r8), intent(out) :: abplnk2(14,pcols,pverp) ! nearest layer factor
1732

1734!---------------------------Local variables-----------------------------
1735!
1736 integer i ! Longitude index
1737 integer k ! Level index]
1738 integer k1 ! Level index

1752!
1753!
1754 real(r8) term7(pcols,2) ! Kl_inf(i) in eq(r8) of table A3a of R&D
1755 real(r8) term8(pcols,2) ! Delta kl_inf(i) in eq(r8)

1757 real(r8) tr2(pcols) ! Equation(6) in table A2 for 500-650

1761! of R&D for 650-800 cm-1 region
1762 real(r8) tr8(pcols) ! Equation (6) times eq(4) in table A2

1775 real(r8) pnewb(nbands) ! Effective pressure for h2o linewidth w/

1779 real(r8) fwk ! Equation(33) in R&D far wing correction
1780 real(r8) troco2(pcols,pverp) ! H2o overlap factor for co2 absorption

1790 real(r8) sum(pcols) ! Used to calculate path temperature

1792 real(r8) sqti ! Sqrt of temperature

1795 real(r8) et2 ! Co2 hot band factor
1796 real(r8) et4 ! Co2 hot band factor

1801 real(r8) f3co2 ! Co2 weak band factor

1804 real(r8) f1sqwp ! Main co2 band factor

1811 real(r8) rbeta9 ! Inverse of co2 hot band line width par
1812 real(r8) rbeta13 ! Inverse of co2 hot band line width par

1816 real(r8) tmp3 ! Co2 band factor
1817 real(r8) tlayr5 ! Temperature factor in co2 Planck func

1821 real(r8) u8 ! Absorber amt for various co2 band systems
1822 real(r8) u9 ! Absorber amt for various co2 band systems
1823 real(r8) u13 ! Absorber amt for various co2 band systems
1824 real(r8) r250 ! Inverse 250K

1831 real(r8) dbvtt(pcols) ! Tmp drvtv of planck fctn for tplnke
1832 real(r8) dbvt,fo3,t,ux,vx
1833 real(r8) te ! Temperature factor
1834 real(r8) u1 ! Path length factor
1835 real(r8) u2 ! Path length factor
1836 real(r8) phat ! Effecitive path length pressure
1837 real(r8) tlocal ! Local planck function temperature
1838 real(r8) tcrfac ! Scaled temperature factor
1839 real(r8) beta ! Absorption funct factor voigt effect
1840 real(r8) realnu ! Absorption function factor
1841 real(r8) o3bndi ! Band absorption factor

1846 real(r8) tco2(pcols) ! co2 overlap factor
1847 real(r8) th2o(pcols) ! h2o overlap factor
1848 real(r8) to3(pcols) ! o3 overlap factor

1852! Notation:
1853! U = integral (P/P_0 dW) eq. 15 in Ramanathan/Downey 1986
1854! P = atmospheric pressure
1855! P_0 = reference atmospheric pressure
1856! W = precipitable water path
1857! T_e = emission temperature
1858! T_p = path temperature

1860!
1861 real(r8) fe ! asymptotic value of emis. as U->infinity
1862 real(r8) e_star ! normalized non-window emissivity
1863 real(r8) l_star ! interpolated line transmission
1864 real(r8) c_star ! interpolated continuum transmission
1865
1866 real(r8) te1 ! emission temperature
1867 real(r8) te2 ! te^2
1868 real(r8) te3 ! te^3

1871
1872 real(r8) log_u ! log base 10 of U

1875 real(r8) t_p ! T_p
1876 real(r8) t_e ! T_e (offset by T_p)
1877
1878 integer iu ! index for log10(U)
1879 integer iu1 ! iu + 1
1880 integer iuc ! index for log10(H2O continuum path)
1881 integer iuc1 ! iuc + 1

1890

1894

1898 real(r8) wuc1 ! 1 - wuc

1902 real(r8) wtp1 ! 1 - wtp
1903 real(r8) wte ! weight for T_e
1904 real(r8) wte1 ! 1 - wte

1907

1909 real(r8) w_0_1_ ! weight for Tp/Te combination

1912

1914 real(r8) w_0_01 ! weight for Tp/Te/RH combination
1915 real(r8) w_0_10 ! weight for Tp/Te/RH combination
1916 real(r8) w_0_11 ! weight for Tp/Te/RH combination
1917 real(r8) w_1_00 ! weight for Tp/Te/RH combination

1919 real(r8) w_1_10 ! weight for Tp/Te/RH combination

1921

1924 real(r8) w00_10 ! weight for P/Tp/Te/RH combination
1925 real(r8) w00_11 ! weight for P/Tp/Te/RH combination
1926 real(r8) w01_00 ! weight for P/Tp/Te/RH combination
1927 real(r8) w01_01 ! weight for P/Tp/Te/RH combination
1928 real(r8) w01_10 ! weight for P/Tp/Te/RH combination
1929 real(r8) w01_11 ! weight for P/Tp/Te/RH combination
1930 real(r8) w10_00 ! weight for P/Tp/Te/RH combination
1931 real(r8) w10_01 ! weight for P/Tp/Te/RH combination
1932 real(r8) w10_10 ! weight for P/Tp/Te/RH combination
1933 real(r8) w10_11 ! weight for P/Tp/Te/RH combination
1934 real(r8) w11_00 ! weight for P/Tp/Te/RH combination
1935 real(r8) w11_01 ! weight for P/Tp/Te/RH combination
1936 real(r8) w11_10 ! weight for P/Tp/Te/RH combination
1937 real(r8) w11_11 ! weight for P/Tp/Te/RH combination
1938
1939 integer ib ! spectral interval:
1940 ! 1 = 0-800 cm^-1 and 1200-2200 cm^-1
1941 ! 2 = 800-1200 cm^-1
1942
1943 real(r8) pch2o ! H2O continuum path
1944 real(r8) fch2o ! temp. factor for continuum
1945 real(r8) uch2o ! U corresponding to H2O cont. path (window)
1946
1947 real(r8) fdif ! secant(zenith angle) for diffusivity approx.
1948
1949 real(r8) sslp_mks ! Sea-level pressure in MKS units
1950 real(r8) esx ! saturation vapor pressure returned by qsat
1951 real(r8) qsx ! saturation mixing ratio returned by qsat
1952 real(r8) pnew_mks ! pnew in MKS units
1953 real(r8) q_path ! effective specific humidity along path
1954 real(r8) rh_path ! effective relative humidity along path
1955
1956!
1957!---------------------------Statement functions-------------------------
1958!
1959! Derivative of planck function at 9.6 micro-meter wavelength, and
1960! an absorption function factor:
1961!
1962!
1963 dbvt(t)=(-2.8911366682e-4_r8+(2.3771251896e-6_r8+1.1305188929e-10_r8*t)*t)/ &
1964 (1.0_r8+(-6.1364820707e-3_r8+1.5550319767e-5_r8*t)*t)
1965!
1966 fo3(ux,vx)=ux/sqrt(4._r8+ux*(1._r8+vx))
1967!
1968!
1969!
1970!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
1971!
1972! Initialize
1973!
1974 r250 = 1._r8/250._r8
1975 r300 = 1._r8/300._r8
1976 rsslp = 1._r8/sslp
1977 rmw = amd/amco2
1978 do i=1,ncol
1979 co2vmr(i) = co2mmr(i) * rmw
1980 end do
1981!
1982! Constants for computing U corresponding to H2O cont. path
1983!
1984 fdif = 1.66_r8
1985 sslp_mks = sslp / 10.0_r8
1986!
1987! Planck function for co2
1988!
1989 do i=1,ncol
1990 ex = exp(960._r8/tplnke(i))
1991 co2plk(i) = 5.e8_r8/((tplnke(i)**4)*(ex - 1._r8))
1992 co2t(i,ntoplw) = tplnke(i)
1993 sum(i) = co2t(i,ntoplw)*pnm(i,ntoplw)
1994 end do
1995 k = ntoplw
1996 do k1=pverp,ntoplw+1,-1
1997 k = k + 1
1998 do i=1,ncol
1999 sum(i) = sum(i) + tlayr(i,k)*(pnm(i,k)-pnm(i,k-1))
2000 ex = exp(960._r8/tlayr(i,k1))
2001 tlayr5 = tlayr(i,k1)*tlayr4(i,k1)
2002 co2eml(i,k1-1) = 1.2e11_r8*ex/(tlayr5*(ex - 1._r8)**2)
2003 co2t(i,k) = sum(i)/pnm(i,k)
2004 end do
2005 end do
2006!
2007! Initialize planck function derivative for O3
2008!
2009 do i=1,ncol
2010 dbvtt(i) = dbvt(tplnke(i))
2011 end do
2012!
2013! Calculate trace gas Planck functions
2014!
2015 call trcplk(ncol , &
2016 tint ,tlayr ,tplnke ,emplnk ,abplnk1 , &
2017 abplnk2 )
2018
2019 if ( ntoplw > 1 )then
2020 emstot(:ncol,:ntoplw-1) = 0._r8
2021 end if
2022
2023!
2024! Interface loop
2025!
2026 do k1=ntoplw,pverp
2027!
2028! H2O emissivity
2029!
2030! emis(i,1) 0 - 800 cm-1 h2o rotation band
2031! emis(i,1) 1200 - 2200 cm-1 h2o vibration-rotation band
2032! emis(i,2) 800 - 1200 cm-1 h2o window
2033!
2034! Separation between rotation and vibration-rotation dropped, so
2035! only 2 slots needed for H2O emissivity
2036!
2037! emis(i,3) = 0.0
2038!
2039! For the p type continuum
2040!
2041 do i=1,ncol
2042 u(i) = plh2o(i,k1)
2043 pnew = u(i)/w(i,k1)
2044 pnew_mks = pnew * sslp_mks
2045!
2046! Apply scaling factor for 500-800 continuum
2047!
2048 uc1(i) = (s2c(i,k1) + 1.7e-3_r8*plh2o(i,k1))*(1._r8 + 2._r8*s2c(i,k1))/ &
2049 (1._r8 + 15._r8*s2c(i,k1))
2050 pch2o = s2c(i,k1)
2051!
2052! Changed effective path temperature to std. Curtis-Godson form
2053!
2054 tpathe = tcg(i,k1)/w(i,k1)
2055 t_p = min(max(tpathe, min_tp_h2o), max_tp_h2o)
2056
2057 call qsat_water(t_p, pnew_mks, esx, qsx)
2058
2059!
2060! Compute effective RH along path
2061!
2062 q_path = w(i,k1) / pnm(i,k1) / rga
2063!
2064! Calculate effective u, pnew for each band using
2065! Hulst-Curtis-Godson approximation:
2066! Formulae: Goody and Yung, Atmospheric Radiation: Theoretical Basis,
2067! 2nd edition, Oxford University Press, 1989.
2068! Effective H2O path (w)
2069! eq. 6.24, p. 228
2070! Effective H2O path pressure (pnew = u/w):
2071! eq. 6.29, p. 228
2072!
2073 ub(1) = plh2ob(1,i,k1) / psi(t_p,1)
2074 ub(2) = plh2ob(2,i,k1) / psi(t_p,2)
2075
2076 pnewb(1) = ub(1) / wb(1,i,k1) * phi(t_p,1)
2077 pnewb(2) = ub(2) / wb(2,i,k1) * phi(t_p,2)
2078!
2079!
2080!
2081 dtx(i) = tplnke(i) - 250._r8
2082 dty(i) = tpathe - 250._r8
2083!
2084! Define variables for C/H/E (now C/LT/E) fit
2085!
2086! emis(i,1) 0 - 800 cm-1 h2o rotation band
2087! emis(i,1) 1200 - 2200 cm-1 h2o vibration-rotation band
2088! emis(i,2) 800 - 1200 cm-1 h2o window
2089!
2090! Separation between rotation and vibration-rotation dropped, so
2091! only 2 slots needed for H2O emissivity
2092!
2093! emis(i,3) = 0.0
2094!
2095! Notation:
2096! U = integral (P/P_0 dW)
2097! P = atmospheric pressure
2098! P_0 = reference atmospheric pressure
2099! W = precipitable water path

2148! H2O Continuum path for 0-800 and 1200-2200 cm^-1
2149!
2150! Assume foreign continuum dominates total H2O continuum in these bands
2151! per Clough et al, JGR, v. 97, no. D14 (Oct 20, 1992), p. 15776
2152! Then the effective H2O path is just
2153! U_c = integral[ f(P) dW ]
2154! where
2155! W = water-vapor mass and
2156! f(P) = dependence of foreign continuum on pressure
2157! = P / sslp
2158! Then
2159! U_c = U (the same effective H2O path as for lines)
2160!
2161!
2162! Continuum terms for 800-1200 cm^-1
2163!
2164! Assume self continuum dominates total H2O continuum for this band
2165! per Clough et al, JGR, v. 97, no. D14 (Oct 20, 1992), p. 15776
2166! Then the effective H2O self-continuum path is
2167! U_c = integral[ h(e,T) dW ] (*eq. 1*)
2168! where
2169! W = water-vapor mass and
2170! e = partial pressure of H2O along path
2171! T = temperature along path
2172! h(e,T) = dependence of foreign continuum on e,T
2173! = e / sslp * f(T)
2174!
2175! Replacing
2176! e =~ q * P / epsilo
2177! q = mixing ratio of H2O
2178! epsilo = 0.622
2179!
2180! and using the definition
2181! U = integral [ (P / sslp) dW ]
2182! = (P / sslp) W (homogeneous path)
2183!
2184! the effective path length for the self continuum is
2185! U_c = (q / epsilo) f(T) U (*eq. 2*)
2186!
2187! Once values of T, U, and q have been calculated for the inhomogeneous
2188! path, this sets U_c for the corresponding
2189! homogeneous atmosphere. However, this need not equal the
2190! value of U_c' defined by eq. 1 for the actual inhomogeneous atmosphere
2191! under consideration.
2192!
2193! Solution: hold T and q constant, solve for U' that gives U_c' by
2194! inverting eq. (2):
2195!
2196! U' = (U_c * epsilo) / (q * f(T))
2197!
2198 fch2o = fh2oself(t_p)
2199 uch2o = (pch2o * epsilo) / (q_path * fch2o)

2433!

2436 do i=1,ncol
2437 term7(i,1) = coefj(1,1) + coefj(2,1)*dty(i)*(1._r8+c16*dty(i))

2442 do i=1,ncol
2443!
2444! 500 - 800 cm-1 rotation band overlap with co2
2445!
2446 k21(i) = term7(i,1) + term8(i,1)/ &
2447 (1._r8 + (c30 + c31*(dty(i)-10._r8)*(dty(i)-10._r8))*sqrt(u(i)))
2448 k22(i) = term7(i,2) + term8(i,2)/ &
2449 (1._r8 + (c28 + c29*(dty(i)-10._r8))*sqrt(u(i)))
2450 fwk = fwcoef + fwc1/(1._r8+fwc2*u(i))
2451 tr1(i) = exp(-(k21(i)*(sqrt(u(i)) + fc1*fwk*u(i))))
2452 tr2(i) = exp(-(k22(i)*(sqrt(u(i)) + fc1*fwk*u(i))))
2453 tr1(i)=tr1(i)*aer_trn_ttl(i,k1,1,idx_LW_0650_0800)
2454! ! H2O line+aer trn 650--800 cm-1

2456! ! H2O line+aer trn 500--650 cm-1
2457 tr3(i) = exp(-((coefh(1,1) + coefh(2,1)*dtx(i))*uc1(i)))
2458 tr4(i) = exp(-((coefh(1,2) + coefh(2,2)*dtx(i))*uc1(i)))
2459 tr7(i) = tr1(i)*tr3(i)
2460 tr8(i) = tr2(i)*tr4(i)
2461 troco2(i,k1) = 0.65_r8*tr7(i) + 0.35_r8*tr8(i)
