2464!
2465! CO2 emissivity for 15 micron band system
2466!
2467 do i=1,ncol
2468 t1i = exp(-480._r8/co2t(i,k1))
2469 sqti = sqrt(co2t(i,k1))
2470 rsqti = 1._r8/sqti
2471 et = t1i
2472 et2 = et*et
2473 et4 = et2*et2
2474 omet = 1._r8 - 1.5_r8*et2
2475 f1co2 = 899.70_r8*omet*(1._r8 + 1.94774_r8*et + 4.73486_r8*et2)*rsqti
2476 sqwp = sqrt(plco2(i,k1))
2477 f1sqwp = f1co2*sqwp
2478 t1co2 = 1._r8/(1._r8 + 245.18_r8*omet*sqwp*rsqti)
2479 oneme = 1._r8 - et2
2480 alphat = oneme**3*rsqti
2481 wco2 = 2.5221_r8*co2vmr(i)*pnm(i,k1)*rga
2482 u7 = 4.9411e4_r8*alphat*et2*wco2
2483 u8 = 3.9744e4_r8*alphat*et4*wco2
2484 u9 = 1.0447e5_r8*alphat*et4*et2*wco2
2485 u13 = 2.8388e3_r8*alphat*et4*wco2
2486!
2487 tpath = co2t(i,k1)
2488 tlocal = tplnke(i)
2489 tcrfac = sqrt((tlocal*r250)*(tpath*r300))
2490 pi = pnm(i,k1)*rsslp + 2._r8*dpfco2*tcrfac
2491 posqt = pi/(2._r8*sqti)
2492 rbeta7 = 1._r8/( 5.3288_r8*posqt)
2493 rbeta8 = 1._r8/ (10.6576_r8*posqt)
2494 rbeta9 = rbeta7
2495 rbeta13= rbeta9
2496 f2co2 = (u7/sqrt(4._r8 + u7*(1._r8 + rbeta7))) + &
2497 (u8/sqrt(4._r8 + u8*(1._r8 + rbeta8))) + &
2498 (u9/sqrt(4._r8 + u9*(1._r8 + rbeta9)))
2499 f3co2 = u13/sqrt(4._r8 + u13*(1._r8 + rbeta13))
2500 tmp1 = log(1._r8 + f1sqwp)
2501 tmp2 = log(1._r8 + f2co2)
2502 tmp3 = log(1._r8 + f3co2)
2503 absbnd = (tmp1 + 2._r8*t1co2*tmp2 + 2._r8*tmp3)*sqti
2504 tco2(i)=1.0_r8/(1.0_r8+10.0_r8*(u7/sqrt(4._r8 + u7*(1._r8 + rbeta7))))
2505 co2ems(i,k1) = troco2(i,k1)*absbnd*co2plk(i)
2506 ex = exp(960._r8/tint(i,k1))
2507 exm1sq = (ex - 1._r8)**2
2508 co2em(i,k1) = 1.2e11_r8*ex/(tint(i,k1)*tint4(i,k1)*exm1sq)
2509 end do
2510!
2511! O3 emissivity
2512!
2513 do i=1,ncol
2514 h2otr(i,k1) = exp(-12._r8*s2c(i,k1))
2515 h2otr(i,k1)=h2otr(i,k1)*aer_trn_ttl(i,k1,1,idx_LW_1000_1200)
2516 te = (co2t(i,k1)/293._r8)**.7_r8
2517 u1 = 18.29_r8*plos(i,k1)/te
2518 u2 = .5649_r8*plos(i,k1)/te
2519 phat = plos(i,k1)/plol(i,k1)
2520 tlocal = tplnke(i)
2521 tcrfac = sqrt(tlocal*r250)*te
2522 beta = (1._r8/.3205_r8)*((1._r8/phat) + (dpfo3*tcrfac))
2523 realnu = (1._r8/beta)*te
2524 o3bndi = 74._r8*te*(tplnke(i)/375._r8)*log(1._r8 + fo3(u1,realnu) + fo3(u2,realnu))
2525 o3ems(i,k1) = dbvtt(i)*h2otr(i,k1)*o3bndi
2526 to3(i)=1.0_r8/(1._r8 + 0.1_r8*fo3(u1,realnu) + 0.1_r8*fo3(u2,realnu))
2527 end do
2528!
2529! Calculate trace gas emissivities
2530!
2531 call trcems(ncol , &
2532 k1 ,co2t ,pnm ,ucfc11 ,ucfc12 , &
2533 un2o0 ,un2o1 ,bn2o0 ,bn2o1 ,uch4 , &
2534 bch4 ,uco211 ,uco212 ,uco213 ,uco221 , &
2535 uco222 ,uco223 ,uptype ,w ,s2c , &
2536 u ,emplnk ,th2o ,tco2 ,to3 , &
2537 emstrc , &
2538 aer_trn_ttl)
2539!
2540! Total emissivity:
2541!
2542 do i=1,ncol
2543 emstot(i,k1) = h2oems(i,k1) + co2ems(i,k1) + o3ems(i,k1) &
2544 + emstrc(i,k1)
2545 end do
2546 end do ! End of interface loop
2547
2548end subroutine radems
2549
2550!====================================================================================
2551
2552subroutine radtpl(ncol , &
2553 tnm ,lwupcgs ,qnm ,pnm ,plco2 ,plh2o , &
2554 tplnka ,s2c ,tcg ,w ,tplnke , &
2555 tint ,tint4 ,tlayr ,tlayr4 ,pmln , &
2556 piln ,plh2ob ,wb ,co2mmr)
2557!--------------------------------------------------------------------
2558!
2559! Purpose:
2560! Compute temperatures and path lengths for longwave radiation
2561!
2562! Method:
2563! <Describe the algorithm(s) used in the routine.>
2564! <Also include any applicable external references.>
2565!
2566! Author: CCM1
2567!------------------------------Arguments-----------------------------
2568!
2569! Input arguments
2570!
2571 integer, intent(in) :: ncol ! number of atmospheric columns
2572
2573 real(r8), intent(in) :: tnm(pcols,pver) ! Model level temperatures
2574 real(r8), intent(in) :: lwupcgs(pcols) ! Surface longwave up flux
2575 real(r8), intent(in) :: qnm(pcols,pver) ! Model level specific humidity
2576 real(r8), intent(in) :: pnm(pcols,pverp) ! Pressure at model interfaces (dynes/cm2)
2577 real(r8), intent(in) :: pmln(pcols,pver) ! Ln(pmidm1)
2578 real(r8), intent(in) :: piln(pcols,pverp) ! Ln(pintm1)
2579 real(r8), intent(in) :: co2mmr(pcols) ! co2 column mean mass mixing ratio
2580!
2581! Output arguments
2582!
2583 real(r8), intent(out) :: plco2(pcols,pverp) ! Pressure weighted co2 path
2584 real(r8), intent(out) :: plh2o(pcols,pverp) ! Pressure weighted h2o path
2585 real(r8), intent(out) :: tplnka(pcols,pverp) ! Level temperature from interface temperatures
2586 real(r8), intent(out) :: s2c(pcols,pverp) ! H2o continuum path length
2587 real(r8), intent(out) :: tcg(pcols,pverp) ! H2o-mass-wgted temp. (Curtis-Godson approx.)
2588 real(r8), intent(out) :: w(pcols,pverp) ! H2o path length
2589 real(r8), intent(out) :: tplnke(pcols) ! Equal to tplnka
2590 real(r8), intent(out) :: tint(pcols,pverp) ! Layer interface temperature
2591 real(r8), intent(out) :: tint4(pcols,pverp) ! Tint to the 4th power
2592 real(r8), intent(out) :: tlayr(pcols,pverp) ! K-1 level temperature
2593 real(r8), intent(out) :: tlayr4(pcols,pverp) ! Tlayr to the 4th power
2594 real(r8), intent(out) :: plh2ob(nbands,pcols,pverp)! Pressure weighted h2o path with
2595 ! Hulst-Curtis-Godson temp. factor
2596 ! for H2O bands
2597 real(r8), intent(out) :: wb(nbands,pcols,pverp) ! H2o path length with
2598 ! Hulst-Curtis-Godson temp. factor
2599 ! for H2O bands
2600
2601!
2602!---------------------------Local variables--------------------------
2603!
2604 integer i ! Longitude index
2605 integer k ! Level index
2606 integer kp1 ! Level index + 1
2607
2608 real(r8) repsil ! Inver ratio mol weight h2o to dry air
2609 real(r8) dy ! Thickness of layer for tmp interp
2610 real(r8) dpnm ! Pressure thickness of layer
2611 real(r8) dpnmsq ! Prs squared difference across layer
2612 real(r8) dw ! Increment in H2O path length
2613 real(r8) dplh2o ! Increment in plh2o
2614 real(r8) cpwpl ! Const in co2 mix ratio to path length conversn
2615
2616!--------------------------------------------------------------------
2617!
2618 repsil = 1._r8/epsilo
2619!
2620! Compute co2 and h2o paths
2621!
2622 cpwpl = 0.5_r8/(gravit_cgs*p0)
2623 do i=1,ncol
2624 plh2o(i,ntoplw) = rgsslp*qnm(i,ntoplw)*pnm(i,ntoplw)*pnm(i,ntoplw)
2625 plco2(i,ntoplw) = co2mmr(i)*cpwpl*pnm(i,ntoplw)*pnm(i,ntoplw)
2626 end do
2627 do k=ntoplw,pver
2628 do i=1,ncol
2629 plh2o(i,k+1) = plh2o(i,k) + rgsslp* &
2630 (pnm(i,k+1)**2 - pnm(i,k)**2)*qnm(i,k)
2631 plco2(i,k+1) = co2mmr(i)*cpwpl*pnm(i,k+1)**2
2632 end do
2633 end do
2634!
2635! Set the top and bottom intermediate level temperatures,
2636! top level planck temperature and top layer temp**4.
2637!
2638! Tint is lower interface temperature
2639! (not available for bottom layer, so use ground temperature)
2640!
2641 do i=1,ncol
2642 tint4(i,pverp) = lwupcgs(i)/stebol_cgs
2643 tint(i,pverp) = sqrt(sqrt(tint4(i,pverp)))
2644 tplnka(i,ntoplw) = tnm(i,ntoplw)
2645 tint(i,ntoplw) = tplnka(i,ntoplw)
2646 tlayr4(i,ntoplw) = tplnka(i,ntoplw)**4
2647 tint4(i,ntoplw) = tlayr4(i,ntoplw)
2648 end do
2649!
2650! Intermediate level temperatures are computed using temperature
2651! at the full level below less dy*delta t,between the full level
2652!
2653 do k=ntoplw+1,pver
2654 do i=1,ncol
2655 dy = (piln(i,k) - pmln(i,k))/(pmln(i,k-1) - pmln(i,k))
2656 tint(i,k) = tnm(i,k) - dy*(tnm(i,k)-tnm(i,k-1))
2657 tint4(i,k) = tint(i,k)**4
2658 end do
2659 end do
2660!
2661! Now set the layer temp=full level temperatures and establish a
2662! planck temperature for absorption (tplnka) which is the average
2663! the intermediate level temperatures. Note that tplnka is not
2664! equal to the full level temperatures.
2665!
2666 do k=ntoplw+1,pverp
2667 do i=1,ncol
2668 tlayr(i,k) = tnm(i,k-1)
2669 tlayr4(i,k) = tlayr(i,k)**4
2670 tplnka(i,k) = .5_r8*(tint(i,k) + tint(i,k-1))
2671 end do
2672 end do
2673!
2674! Calculate tplank for emissivity calculation.
2675! Assume isothermal tplnke i.e. all levels=ttop.
2676!
2677 do i=1,ncol
2678 tplnke(i) = tplnka(i,ntoplw)
2679 tlayr(i,ntoplw) = tint(i,ntoplw)
2680 end do
2681!
2682! Now compute h2o path fields:
2683!
2684 do i=1,ncol
2685!
2686! Changed effective path temperature to std. Curtis-Godson form
2687!
2688 tcg(i,ntoplw) = rga*qnm(i,ntoplw)*pnm(i,ntoplw)*tnm(i,ntoplw)
2689 w(i,ntoplw) = sslp * (plh2o(i,ntoplw)*2._r8) / pnm(i,ntoplw)
2690!
2691! Hulst-Curtis-Godson scaling for H2O path
2692!
2693 wb(1,i,ntoplw) = w(i,ntoplw) * phi(tnm(i,ntoplw),1)
2694 wb(2,i,ntoplw) = w(i,ntoplw) * phi(tnm(i,ntoplw),2)
2695!
2696! Hulst-Curtis-Godson scaling for effective pressure along H2O path
2697!
2698 plh2ob(1,i,ntoplw) = plh2o(i,ntoplw) * psi(tnm(i,ntoplw),1)
2699 plh2ob(2,i,ntoplw) = plh2o(i,ntoplw) * psi(tnm(i,ntoplw),2)
2700
2701 s2c(i,ntoplw) = plh2o(i,ntoplw)*fh2oself(tnm(i,ntoplw))*qnm(i,ntoplw)*repsil
2702 end do
2703
2704 do k=ntoplw,pver
2705 do i=1,ncol
2706 dpnm = pnm(i,k+1) - pnm(i,k)
2707 dpnmsq = pnm(i,k+1)**2 - pnm(i,k)**2
2708 dw = rga*qnm(i,k)*dpnm
2709 kp1 = k+1
2710 w(i,kp1) = w(i,k) + dw
2711!
2712! Hulst-Curtis-Godson scaling for H2O path
2713!
2714 wb(1,i,kp1) = wb(1,i,k) + dw * phi(tnm(i,k),1)
2715 wb(2,i,kp1) = wb(2,i,k) + dw * phi(tnm(i,k),2)
2716!
2717! Hulst-Curtis-Godson scaling for effective pressure along H2O path
2718!
2719 dplh2o = plh2o(i,kp1) - plh2o(i,k)
2720
2721 plh2ob(1,i,kp1) = plh2ob(1,i,k) + dplh2o * psi(tnm(i,k),1)
2722 plh2ob(2,i,kp1) = plh2ob(2,i,k) + dplh2o * psi(tnm(i,k),2)
2723!
2724! Changed effective path temperature to std. Curtis-Godson form
2725!
2726 tcg(i,kp1) = tcg(i,k) + dw*tnm(i,k)
2727 s2c(i,kp1) = s2c(i,k) + rgsslp*dpnmsq*qnm(i,k)* &
2728 fh2oself(tnm(i,k))*qnm(i,k)*repsil
2729 end do
2730 end do
2731
2732end subroutine radtpl
2733
2734!====================================================================================
2735
2736subroutine radae_init(gravx, epsilox, stebol, pstdx, mwdryx, mwco2x, mwo3x)
2737!
2738! Initialize radae module data
2739!
2740 use pio, only: file_desc_t, var_desc_t, pio_inq_dimid, pio_inquire_dimension, &
2741 pio_inquire_variable, pio_inq_varid, pio_get_var, pio_nowrite, &
2742 pio_max_var_dims, pio_max_name, pio_closefile
2743 use cam_pio_utils,only: cam_pio_openfile
2744 use ioFileMod, only: getfil
2745 use filenames, only: absems_data
2746
2747!
2748! Input variables
2749!
2750 real(r8), intent(in) :: gravx ! Acceleration due to gravity (m/s**2)
2751 real(r8), intent(in) :: epsilox ! Ratio of mol. wght of H2O to dry air
2752 real(r8), intent(in) :: stebol ! Stefan-Boltzmann's constant (MKS)
2753 real(r8), intent(in) :: pstdx ! Standard pressure (pascals)
2754 real(r8), intent(in) :: mwdryx ! Molecular weight of dry air
2755 real(r8), intent(in) :: mwco2x ! Molecular weight of carbon dioxide
2756 real(r8), intent(in) :: mwo3x ! Molecular weight of ozone
2757!
2758! Variables for loading absorptivity/emissivity
2759!
2760 type(file_desc_T) :: ncid_ae ! NetCDF file id for abs/ems file
2761
2762 integer pdimid ! pressure dimension id
2763 integer psize ! pressure dimension size
2764
2765 integer tpdimid ! path temperature dimension id
2766 integer tpsize ! path temperature size
2767
2768 integer tedimid ! emission temperature dimension id
2769 integer tesize ! emission temperature size
2770
2771 integer udimid ! u (H2O path) dimension id
2772 integer usize ! u (H2O path) dimension size
2773
2774 integer rhdimid ! relative humidity dimension id
2775 integer rhsize ! relative humidity dimension size
2776
2777 type(var_desc_t) :: ah2onwid ! var. id for non-wndw abs.
2778 type(var_desc_t) :: eh2onwid ! var. id for non-wndw ems.
2779 type(var_desc_t) :: ah2owid ! var. id for wndw abs. (adjacent layers)
2780 type(var_desc_t) :: cn_ah2owid ! var. id for continuum trans. for wndw abs.
2781 type(var_desc_t) :: cn_eh2owid ! var. id for continuum trans. for wndw ems.
2782 type(var_desc_t) :: ln_ah2owid ! var. id for line trans. for wndw abs.
2783 type(var_desc_t) :: ln_eh2owid ! var. id for line trans. for wndw ems.
2784
2785 character*(PIO_MAX_NAME) tmpname! dummy variable for var/dim names
2786 character(len=256) locfn ! local filename
2787 integer tmptype ! dummy variable for variable type
2788 integer ndims ! number of dimensions
2789 integer dims(PIO_MAX_VAR_DIMS) ! vector of dimension ids
2790 integer natt ! number of attributes
2791
2792 integer ierr ! ierr flag returned from pio (pio handles errors internally so it is not checked)
2793!
2794! Constants to set
2795!
2796 gravit = gravx
2797 gravit_cgs = 100._r8*gravx
2798 rga = 1._r8/gravit_cgs
2799 epsilo = epsilox
2800 omeps = 1._r8 - epsilo
2801 sslp = 1.013250e6_r8
2802 stebol_cgs = 1.e3_r8*stebol
2803 rgsslp = 0.5_r8/(gravit_cgs*sslp)
2804 dpfo3 = 2.5e-3_r8
2805 dpfco2 = 5.0e-3_r8
2806
2807 p0 = pstdx*10.0_r8
2808 amd = mwdryx
2809 amco2 = mwco2x
2810 mwo3 = mwo3x
2811!
2812! Coefficients for h2o emissivity and absorptivity for overlap of H2O
2813! and trace gases.
2814!
2815 c16 = coefj(3,1)/coefj(2,1)
2816 c17 = coefk(3,1)/coefk(2,1)
2817 c26 = coefj(3,2)/coefj(2,2)
2818 c27 = coefk(3,2)/coefk(2,2)
2819 c28 = .5_r8
2820 c29 = .002053_r8
2821 c30 = .1_r8
2822 c31 = 3.0e-5_r8
2823!
2824! Initialize further longwave constants referring to far wing
2825! correction for overlap of H2O and trace gases; R&D refers to:
2826!
2827! Ramanathan, V. and P.Downey, 1986: A Nonisothermal
2828! Emissivity and Absorptivity Formulation for Water Vapor
2829! Journal of Geophysical Research, vol. 91., D8, pp 8649-8666
2830!
2831 fwcoef = .1_r8 ! See eq(33) R&D
2832 fwc1 = .30_r8 ! See eq(33) R&D
2833 fwc2 = 4.5_r8 ! See eq(33) and eq(34) in R&D
2834 fc1 = 2.6_r8 ! See eq(34) R&D
2835
2836 call getfil(absems_data, locfn)
2837 call cam_pio_openfile(ncid_ae, locfn, PIO_NOWRITE)
2838
2839 ierr = pio_inq_dimid(ncid_ae, 'p', pdimid)
2840 ierr = pio_inquire_dimension(ncid_ae, pdimid, len=psize)
2841
2842 ierr = pio_inq_dimid(ncid_ae, 'tp', tpdimid)
2843 ierr = pio_inquire_dimension(ncid_ae, tpdimid, len=tpsize)
2844
2845 ierr = pio_inq_dimid(ncid_ae, 'te', tedimid)
2846 ierr = pio_inquire_dimension(ncid_ae, tedimid, len=tesize)
2847
2848 ierr = pio_inq_dimid(ncid_ae, 'u', udimid)
2849 ierr = pio_inquire_dimension(ncid_ae, udimid, len=usize)
2850
2851 ierr = pio_inq_dimid(ncid_ae, 'rh', rhdimid)
2852 ierr = pio_inquire_dimension(ncid_ae, rhdimid, len=rhsize)
2853
2854 if (psize /= n_p .or. &
2855 tpsize /= n_tp .or. &
2856 usize /= n_u .or. &
2857 tesize /= n_te .or. &
2858 rhsize /= n_rh) then
2859 call endrun ('RADAEINI: dimensions for abs/ems do not match internal def.')
2860 endif
2861
2862 ierr = pio_inq_varid(ncid_ae, 'ah2onw', ah2onwid)
2863 ierr = pio_inq_varid(ncid_ae, 'eh2onw', eh2onwid)
2864 ierr = pio_inq_varid(ncid_ae, 'ah2ow', ah2owid)
2865 ierr = pio_inq_varid(ncid_ae, 'cn_ah2ow', cn_ah2owid)
2866 ierr = pio_inq_varid(ncid_ae, 'cn_eh2ow', cn_eh2owid)
2867 ierr = pio_inq_varid(ncid_ae, 'ln_ah2ow', ln_ah2owid)
2868 ierr = pio_inq_varid(ncid_ae, 'ln_eh2ow', ln_eh2owid)
2869
2870 ierr = pio_inquire_variable(ncid_ae, ah2onwid, tmpname, tmptype, ndims, dims, natt)
2871 if (ndims /= 5 .or. &
2872 dims(1) /= pdimid .or. &
2873 dims(2) /= tpdimid .or. &
2874 dims(3) /= udimid .or. &
2875 dims(4) /= tedimid .or. &
2876 dims(5) /= rhdimid) then
2877 call endrun ('RADAEINI: non-wndw abs. in file /= internal def.')
2878 endif
2879 ierr = pio_inquire_variable(ncid_ae, eh2onwid, tmpname, tmptype, ndims, dims, natt)
2880 if (ndims /= 5 .or. &
2881 dims(1) /= pdimid .or. &
2882 dims(2) /= tpdimid .or. &
2883 dims(3) /= udimid .or. &
2884 dims(4) /= tedimid .or. &
2885 dims(5) /= rhdimid) then
2886 call endrun ('RADAEINI: non-wndw ems. in file /= internal def.')
2887 endif
2888 ierr = pio_inquire_variable(ncid_ae, ah2owid, tmpname, tmptype, ndims, dims, natt)
2889 if (ndims /= 5 .or. &
2890 dims(1) /= pdimid .or. &
2891 dims(2) /= tpdimid .or. &
2892 dims(3) /= udimid .or. &
2893 dims(4) /= tedimid .or. &
2894 dims(5) /= rhdimid) then
2895 call endrun ('RADAEINI: window abs. in file /= internal def.')
2896 endif
2897 ierr = pio_inquire_variable(ncid_ae, cn_ah2owid, tmpname, tmptype, ndims, dims, natt)
2898 if (ndims /= 5 .or. &
2899 dims(1) /= pdimid .or. &
2900 dims(2) /= tpdimid .or. &
2901 dims(3) /= udimid .or. &
2902 dims(4) /= tedimid .or. &
2903 dims(5) /= rhdimid) then
2904 call endrun ('RADAEINI: cont. trans for abs. in file /= internal def.')
2905 endif
2906 ierr = pio_inquire_variable(ncid_ae, cn_eh2owid, tmpname, tmptype, ndims, dims, natt)
2907 if (ndims /= 5 .or. &
2908 dims(1) /= pdimid .or. &
2909 dims(2) /= tpdimid .or. &
2910 dims(3) /= udimid .or. &
2911 dims(4) /= tedimid .or. &
2912 dims(5) /= rhdimid) then
2913 call endrun ('RADAEINI: cont. trans. for ems. in file /= internal def.')
2914 endif
2915 ierr = pio_inquire_variable(ncid_ae, ln_ah2owid, tmpname, tmptype, ndims, dims, natt)
2916 if (ndims /= 5 .or. &
2917 dims(1) /= pdimid .or. &
2918 dims(2) /= tpdimid .or. &
2919 dims(3) /= udimid .or. &
2920 dims(4) /= tedimid .or. &
2921 dims(5) /= rhdimid) then
2922 call endrun ('RADAEINI: line trans for abs. in file /= internal def.')
2923 endif
2924 ierr = pio_inquire_variable(ncid_ae, ln_eh2owid, tmpname, tmptype, ndims, dims, natt)
2925 if (ndims /= 5 .or. &
2926 dims(1) /= pdimid .or. &
2927 dims(2) /= tpdimid .or. &
2928 dims(3) /= udimid .or. &
2929 dims(4) /= tedimid .or. &
2930 dims(5) /= rhdimid) then
2931 call endrun ('RADAEINI: line trans. for ems. in file /= internal def.')
2932 endif
2933
2934 ierr = pio_get_var (ncid_ae, ah2onwid, ah2onw)
2935 ierr = pio_get_var (ncid_ae, eh2onwid, eh2onw)
2936 ierr = pio_get_var (ncid_ae, ah2owid, ah2ow)
2937 ierr = pio_get_var (ncid_ae, cn_ah2owid, cn_ah2ow)
2938 ierr = pio_get_var (ncid_ae, cn_eh2owid, cn_eh2ow)
2939 ierr = pio_get_var (ncid_ae, ln_ah2owid, ln_ah2ow)
2940 ierr = pio_get_var (ncid_ae, ln_eh2owid, ln_eh2ow)
2941
2942 call pio_closefile(ncid_ae)
2943
2944end subroutine radae_init

2948512512subroutine initialize_radbuffer
2949!
2950! Initialize radiation buffer data
2951!
2952
2953 use ref_pres, only : pref_mid
2954 use phys_control, only : phys_getopts
2955
2956 character(len=16) :: radiation_scheme
2957 integer :: k
2958
2959! If the top model level is above ~90 km (0.1 Pa), set the top level to compute
2960! longwave cooling to about 80 km (1 Pa)
2961512512 if (pref_mid(1) .lt. 0.1_r8) then
296200 do k = 1, plev
296300 if (pref_mid(k) .lt. 1._r8) ntoplw = k
2964 end do
2965 else
2966512512 ntoplw = 1
2967 end if
2968512512 if (masterproc) then
296915 write(iulog,*) 'INITIALIZE_RADBUFFER: ntoplw =',ntoplw, ' pressure:',pref_mid(ntoplw)
2970 endif
2971
2972512512 call phys_getopts(radiation_scheme_out=radiation_scheme)
2973
2974512512 if(radiation_scheme.eq.'camrt') then
297500 allocate (abstot_3d(pcols,ntoplw:pverp,ntoplw:pverp,begchunk:endchunk))
297600 allocate (absnxt_3d(pcols,pver,4,begchunk:endchunk))
297700 allocate (emstot_3d(pcols,pverp,begchunk:endchunk))
297800 abstot_3d(:,:,:,:) = posinf
297900 absnxt_3d(:,:,:,:) = posinf
298000 emstot_3d(:,:,:) = posinf
2981 end if
2982 return
2983512512end subroutine initialize_radbuffer

2987subroutine radoz2(ncol, o3, pint, plol, plos)
2988!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
2989!
2990! Purpose:
2991! Computes the path length integrals to the model interfaces given the
2992! ozone volume mixing ratio
2993!
2994! Method:
2995! <Describe the algorithm(s) used in the routine.>
2996! <Also include any applicable external references.>
2997!
2998! Author: CCM1, CMS Contact J. Kiehl
2999!
3000!------------------------------Input arguments--------------------------
3001!
3002 integer, intent(in) :: ncol ! number of atmospheric columns
3003
3004 real(r8), intent(in) :: o3(pcols,pver) ! ozone mass mixing ratio
3005 real(r8), intent(in) :: pint(pcols,pverp) ! Model interface pressures
3006!
3007!----------------------------Output arguments---------------------------
3008!
3009 real(r8), intent(out) :: plol(pcols,pverp) ! Ozone prs weighted path length (cm)
3010 real(r8), intent(out) :: plos(pcols,pverp) ! Ozone path length (cm)
3011!
3012!---------------------------Local workspace-----------------------------
3013!
3014 integer i ! longitude index
3015 integer k ! level index
3016
3017 real(r8) :: v0 ! Volume of a gas at stp (m**3/kmol)
3018 real(r8) :: p0 ! Standard pressure (pascals)
3019 real(r8) :: cplos ! constant for ozone path length integral
3020 real(r8) :: cplol ! constant for ozone path length integral
3021
3022!
3023!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3024!*******************************************************************
3025! These hardwired constants need to be replaced with common values.
3026! They are here for testing infrastructure changes that should not
3027! change answers.
3028! Constants for ozone path integrals (multiplication by 100 for unit
3029! conversion to cgs from mks):
3030!
3031 v0 = 22.4136_r8 ! Volume of a gas at stp (m**3/kmol)
3032 p0 = 0.1_r8*sslp ! Standard pressure (pascals)
3033 cplos = v0/(mwo3*gravit) *100.0_r8
3034 cplol = v0/(mwo3*gravit*p0)*0.5_r8*100.0_r8
3035!*******************************************************************
3036!
3037! Evaluate the ozone path length integrals to interfaces;
3038! factors of .1 and .01 to convert pressures from cgs to mks:
3039!
3040 do i=1,ncol
3041 plos(i,ntoplw) = 0.1_r8 *cplos*o3(i,ntoplw)*pint(i,ntoplw)
3042 plol(i,ntoplw) = 0.01_r8*cplol*o3(i,ntoplw)*pint(i,ntoplw)*pint(i,ntoplw)
3043 end do
3044 do k=ntoplw+1,pverp
3045 do i=1,ncol
3046 plos(i,k) = plos(i,k-1) + 0.1_r8*cplos*o3(i,k-1)*(pint(i,k) - pint(i,k-1))
3047 plol(i,k) = plol(i,k-1) + 0.01_r8*cplol*o3(i,k-1)* &
3048 (pint(i,k)*pint(i,k) - pint(i,k-1)*pint(i,k-1))
3049 end do
3050 end do
3051
3052end subroutine radoz2
3053

3055
3056subroutine trcpth(ncol , &
3057 tnm ,pnm ,cfc11 ,cfc12 ,n2o , &
3058 ch4 ,qnm ,ucfc11 ,ucfc12 ,un2o0 , &
3059 un2o1 ,uch4 ,uco211 ,uco212 ,uco213 , &
3060 uco221 ,uco222 ,uco223 ,bn2o0 ,bn2o1 , &
3061 bch4 ,uptype ,co2mmr)
3062!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3063!
3064! Purpose:
3065! Calculate path lengths and pressure factors for CH4, N2O, CFC11
3066! and CFC12.
3067!
3068! Method:
3069! See CCM3 description for details
3070!
3071! Author: J. Kiehl
3072!
3073!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3074!
3075! Input arguments
3076!
3077 integer, intent(in) :: ncol ! number of atmospheric columns
3078
3079 real(r8), intent(in) :: tnm(pcols,pver) ! Model level temperatures
3080 real(r8), intent(in) :: pnm(pcols,pverp) ! Pres. at model interfaces (dynes/cm2)
3081 real(r8), intent(in) :: qnm(pcols,pver) ! h2o specific humidity
3082 real(r8), intent(in) :: cfc11(pcols,pver) ! CFC11 mass mixing ratio
3083!
3084 real(r8), intent(in) :: cfc12(pcols,pver) ! CFC12 mass mixing ratio
3085 real(r8), intent(in) :: n2o(pcols,pver) ! N2O mass mixing ratio
3086 real(r8), intent(in) :: ch4(pcols,pver) ! CH4 mass mixing ratio
3087 real(r8), intent(in) :: co2mmr(pcols) ! co2 column mean mass mixing ratio
3088
3089!
3090! Output arguments
3091!
3092 real(r8), intent(out) :: ucfc11(pcols,pverp) ! CFC11 path length
3093 real(r8), intent(out) :: ucfc12(pcols,pverp) ! CFC12 path length
3094 real(r8), intent(out) :: un2o0(pcols,pverp) ! N2O path length
3095 real(r8), intent(out) :: un2o1(pcols,pverp) ! N2O path length (hot band)
3096 real(r8), intent(out) :: uch4(pcols,pverp) ! CH4 path length
3097!
3098 real(r8), intent(out) :: uco211(pcols,pverp) ! CO2 9.4 micron band path length
3099 real(r8), intent(out) :: uco212(pcols,pverp) ! CO2 9.4 micron band path length
3100 real(r8), intent(out) :: uco213(pcols,pverp) ! CO2 9.4 micron band path length
3101 real(r8), intent(out) :: uco221(pcols,pverp) ! CO2 10.4 micron band path length
3102 real(r8), intent(out) :: uco222(pcols,pverp) ! CO2 10.4 micron band path length
3103!
3104 real(r8), intent(out) :: uco223(pcols,pverp) ! CO2 10.4 micron band path length
3105 real(r8), intent(out) :: bn2o0(pcols,pverp) ! pressure factor for n2o
3106 real(r8), intent(out) :: bn2o1(pcols,pverp) ! pressure factor for n2o
3107 real(r8), intent(out) :: bch4(pcols,pverp) ! pressure factor for ch4
3108 real(r8), intent(out) :: uptype(pcols,pverp) ! p-type continuum path length
3109
3110!
3111!---------------------------Local variables-----------------------------
3112!
3113 integer i ! Longitude index
3114 integer k ! Level index
3115!
3116 real(r8) co2fac(pcols,1) ! co2 factor
3117 real(r8) alpha1(pcols) ! stimulated emission term
3118 real(r8) alpha2(pcols) ! stimulated emission term
3119 real(r8) rt(pcols) ! reciprocal of local temperature
3120 real(r8) rsqrt(pcols) ! reciprocal of sqrt of temp
3121!
3122 real(r8) pbar(pcols) ! mean pressure
3123 real(r8) dpnm(pcols) ! difference in pressure
3124 real(r8) diff ! diffusivity factor
3125!
3126!--------------------------Data Statements------------------------------
3127!
3128 data diff /1.66_r8/
3129!
3130!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3131!
3132! Calculate path lengths for the trace gases at model top
3133!
3134
3135 do i = 1,ncol
3136 ucfc11(i,ntoplw) = 1.8_r8 * cfc11(i,ntoplw) * pnm(i,ntoplw) * rga
3137 ucfc12(i,ntoplw) = 1.8_r8 * cfc12(i,ntoplw) * pnm(i,ntoplw) * rga
3138 un2o0(i,ntoplw) = diff * 1.02346e5_r8 * n2o(i,ntoplw) * pnm(i,ntoplw) * rga / sqrt(tnm(i,ntoplw))
3139 un2o1(i,ntoplw) = diff * 2.01909_r8 * un2o0(i,ntoplw) * exp(-847.36_r8/tnm(i,ntoplw))
3140 uch4(i,ntoplw) = diff * 8.60957e4_r8 * ch4(i,ntoplw) * pnm(i,ntoplw) * rga / sqrt(tnm(i,ntoplw))
3141 co2fac(i,1) = diff * co2mmr(i) * pnm(i,ntoplw) * rga
3142 alpha1(i) = (1.0_r8 - exp(-1540.0_r8/tnm(i,ntoplw)))**3.0_r8/sqrt(tnm(i,ntoplw))
3143 alpha2(i) = (1.0_r8 - exp(-1360.0_r8/tnm(i,ntoplw)))**3.0_r8/sqrt(tnm(i,ntoplw))
3144 uco211(i,ntoplw) = 3.42217e3_r8 * co2fac(i,1) * alpha1(i) * exp(-1849.7_r8/tnm(i,ntoplw))
3145 uco212(i,ntoplw) = 6.02454e3_r8 * co2fac(i,1) * alpha1(i) * exp(-2782.1_r8/tnm(i,ntoplw))
3146 uco213(i,ntoplw) = 5.53143e3_r8 * co2fac(i,1) * alpha1(i) * exp(-3723.2_r8/tnm(i,ntoplw))
3147 uco221(i,ntoplw) = 3.88984e3_r8 * co2fac(i,1) * alpha2(i) * exp(-1997.6_r8/tnm(i,ntoplw))
3148 uco222(i,ntoplw) = 3.67108e3_r8 * co2fac(i,1) * alpha2(i) * exp(-3843.8_r8/tnm(i,ntoplw))
3149 uco223(i,ntoplw) = 6.50642e3_r8 * co2fac(i,1) * alpha2(i) * exp(-2989.7_r8/tnm(i,ntoplw))
3150 bn2o0(i,ntoplw) = diff * 19.399_r8 * pnm(i,ntoplw)**2.0_r8 * n2o(i,ntoplw) * &
3151 1.02346e5_r8 * rga / (sslp*tnm(i,ntoplw))
3152 bn2o1(i,ntoplw) = bn2o0(i,ntoplw) * exp(-847.36_r8/tnm(i,ntoplw)) * 2.06646e5_r8
3153 bch4(i,ntoplw) = diff * 2.94449_r8 * ch4(i,ntoplw) * pnm(i,ntoplw)**2.0_r8 * rga * &
3154 8.60957e4_r8 / (sslp*tnm(i,ntoplw))
3155 uptype(i,ntoplw) = diff * qnm(i,ntoplw) * pnm(i,ntoplw)**2.0_r8 * &
3156 exp(1800.0_r8*(1.0_r8/tnm(i,ntoplw) - 1.0_r8/296.0_r8)) * rga / sslp
3157 end do
3158!
3159! Calculate trace gas path lengths through model atmosphere
3160!
3161 do k = ntoplw,pver
3162 do i = 1,ncol
3163 rt(i) = 1._r8/tnm(i,k)
3164 rsqrt(i) = sqrt(rt(i))
3165 pbar(i) = 0.5_r8 * (pnm(i,k+1) + pnm(i,k)) / sslp
3166 dpnm(i) = (pnm(i,k+1) - pnm(i,k)) * rga
3167 alpha1(i) = diff * rsqrt(i) * (1.0_r8 - exp(-1540.0_r8/tnm(i,k)))**3.0_r8
3168 alpha2(i) = diff * rsqrt(i) * (1.0_r8 - exp(-1360.0_r8/tnm(i,k)))**3.0_r8
3169 ucfc11(i,k+1) = ucfc11(i,k) + 1.8_r8 * cfc11(i,k) * dpnm(i)
3170 ucfc12(i,k+1) = ucfc12(i,k) + 1.8_r8 * cfc12(i,k) * dpnm(i)
3171 un2o0(i,k+1) = un2o0(i,k) + diff * 1.02346e5_r8 * n2o(i,k) * rsqrt(i) * dpnm(i)
3172 un2o1(i,k+1) = un2o1(i,k) + diff * 2.06646e5_r8 * n2o(i,k) * &
3173 rsqrt(i) * exp(-847.36_r8/tnm(i,k)) * dpnm(i)
3174 uch4(i,k+1) = uch4(i,k) + diff * 8.60957e4_r8 * ch4(i,k) * rsqrt(i) * dpnm(i)
3175 uco211(i,k+1) = uco211(i,k) + 1.15_r8*3.42217e3_r8 * alpha1(i) * &
3176 co2mmr(i) * exp(-1849.7_r8/tnm(i,k)) * dpnm(i)
3177 uco212(i,k+1) = uco212(i,k) + 1.15_r8*6.02454e3_r8 * alpha1(i) * &
3178 co2mmr(i) * exp(-2782.1_r8/tnm(i,k)) * dpnm(i)
3179 uco213(i,k+1) = uco213(i,k) + 1.15_r8*5.53143e3_r8 * alpha1(i) * &
3180 co2mmr(i) * exp(-3723.2_r8/tnm(i,k)) * dpnm(i)
3181 uco221(i,k+1) = uco221(i,k) + 1.15_r8*3.88984e3_r8 * alpha2(i) * &
3182 co2mmr(i) * exp(-1997.6_r8/tnm(i,k)) * dpnm(i)
3183 uco222(i,k+1) = uco222(i,k) + 1.15_r8*3.67108e3_r8 * alpha2(i) * &
3184 co2mmr(i) * exp(-3843.8_r8/tnm(i,k)) * dpnm(i)
3185 uco223(i,k+1) = uco223(i,k) + 1.15_r8*6.50642e3_r8 * alpha2(i) * &
3186 co2mmr(i) * exp(-2989.7_r8/tnm(i,k)) * dpnm(i)
3187 bn2o0(i,k+1) = bn2o0(i,k) + diff * 19.399_r8 * pbar(i) * rt(i) &
3188 * 1.02346e5_r8 * n2o(i,k) * dpnm(i)
3189 bn2o1(i,k+1) = bn2o1(i,k) + diff * 19.399_r8 * pbar(i) * rt(i) &
3190 * 2.06646e5_r8 * exp(-847.36_r8/tnm(i,k)) * n2o(i,k)*dpnm(i)
3191 bch4(i,k+1) = bch4(i,k) + diff * 2.94449_r8 * rt(i) * pbar(i) &
3192 * 8.60957e4_r8 * ch4(i,k) * dpnm(i)
3193 uptype(i,k+1) = uptype(i,k) + diff *qnm(i,k) * &
3194 exp(1800.0_r8*(1.0_r8/tnm(i,k) - 1.0_r8/296.0_r8)) * pbar(i) * dpnm(i)
3195 end do
3196 end do
3197!
3198 return
3199end subroutine trcpth
3200

3206
3207function fh2oself( temp )
3208!
3209! Short function for H2O self-continuum temperature factor in
3210! calculation of effective H2O self-continuum path length
3211!
3212! H2O Continuum: CKD 2.4
3213! Code for continuum: GENLN3
3214! Reference: Edwards, D.P., 1992: GENLN2, A General Line-by-Line Atmospheric
3215! Transmittance and Radiance Model, Version 3.0 Description
3216! and Users Guide, NCAR/TN-367+STR, 147 pp.
3217!
3218! In GENLN, the temperature scaling of the self-continuum is handled
3219! by exponential interpolation/extrapolation from observations at
3220! 260K and 296K by:
3221!
3222! TFAC = (T(IPATH) - 296.0)/(260.0 - 296.0)
3223! CSFFT = CSFF296*(CSFF260/CSFF296)**TFAC
3224!
3225! For 800-1200 cm^-1, (CSFF260/CSFF296) ranges from ~2.1 to ~1.9
3226! with increasing wavenumber. The ratio <CSFF260>/<CSFF296>,
3227! where <> indicates average over wavenumber, is ~2.07
3228!
3229! fh2oself is (<CSFF260>/<CSFF296>)**TFAC
3230!
3231 real(r8),intent(in) :: temp ! path temperature
3232 real(r8) fh2oself ! mean ratio of self-continuum at temp and 296K
3233
3234 fh2oself = 2.0727484_r8**((296.0_r8 - temp) / 36.0_r8)
3235end function fh2oself
3236
3237!====================================================================================
3238
3239function phi(tpx,iband)
3240!
3241! History: First version for Hitran 1996 (C/H/E)
3242! Current version for Hitran 2000 (C/LT/E)
3243! Short function for Hulst-Curtis-Godson temperature factors for
3244! computing effective H2O path
3245! Line data for H2O: Hitran 2000, plus H2O patches v11.0 for 1341 missing
3246! lines between 500 and 2820 cm^-1.
3247! See cfa-www.harvard.edu/HITRAN
3248! Isotopes of H2O: all
3249! Line widths: air-broadened only (self set to 0)
3250! Code for line strengths and widths: GENLN3
3251! Reference: Edwards, D.P., 1992: GENLN2, A General Line-by-Line Atmospheric
3252! Transmittance and Radiance Model, Version 3.0 Description
3253! and Users Guide, NCAR/TN-367+STR, 147 pp.
3254!
3255! Note: functions have been normalized by dividing by their values at
3256! a path temperature of 160K
3257!
3258! spectral intervals:
3259! 1 = 0-800 cm^-1 and 1200-2200 cm^-1
3260! 2 = 800-1200 cm^-1
3261!
3262! Formulae: Goody and Yung, Atmospheric Radiation: Theoretical Basis,
3263! 2nd edition, Oxford University Press, 1989.
3264! Phi: function for H2O path
3265! eq. 6.25, p. 228
3266!
3267 real(r8),intent(in):: tpx ! path temperature
3268 integer, intent(in):: iband ! band to process
3269 real(r8) phi ! phi for given band
3270 real(r8),parameter :: phi_r0(nbands) = (/ 9.60917711E-01_r8, -2.21031342E+01_r8/)
3271 real(r8),parameter :: phi_r1(nbands) = (/ 4.86076751E-04_r8, 4.24062610E-01_r8/)
3272 real(r8),parameter :: phi_r2(nbands) = (/-1.84806265E-06_r8, -2.95543415E-03_r8/)
3273 real(r8),parameter :: phi_r3(nbands) = (/ 2.11239959E-09_r8, 7.52470896E-06_r8/)
3274
3275 phi = (((phi_r3(iband) * tpx) + phi_r2(iband)) * tpx + phi_r1(iband)) &
3276 * tpx + phi_r0(iband)
3277end function phi
3278
3279!====================================================================================
3280
3281function psi(tpx,iband)
3282!
3283! History: First version for Hitran 1996 (C/H/E)
3284! Current version for Hitran 2000 (C/LT/E)
3285! Short function for Hulst-Curtis-Godson temperature factors for
3286! computing effective H2O path
3287! Line data for H2O: Hitran 2000, plus H2O patches v11.0 for 1341 missing
3288! lines between 500 and 2820 cm^-1.
3289! See cfa-www.harvard.edu/HITRAN
3290! Isotopes of H2O: all
3291! Line widths: air-broadened only (self set to 0)
3292! Code for line strengths and widths: GENLN3
3293! Reference: Edwards, D.P., 1992: GENLN2, A General Line-by-Line Atmospheric
3294! Transmittance and Radiance Model, Version 3.0 Description
3295! and Users Guide, NCAR/TN-367+STR, 147 pp.
3296!
3297! Note: functions have been normalized by dividing by their values at
3298! a path temperature of 160K
3299!
3300! spectral intervals:
3301! 1 = 0-800 cm^-1 and 1200-2200 cm^-1
3302! 2 = 800-1200 cm^-1
3303!
3304! Formulae: Goody and Yung, Atmospheric Radiation: Theoretical Basis,
3305! 2nd edition, Oxford University Press, 1989.
3306! Psi: function for pressure along path
3307! eq. 6.30, p. 228
3308!
3309 real(r8),intent(in):: tpx ! path temperature
3310 integer, intent(in):: iband ! band to process
3311 real(r8) psi ! psi for given band
3312 real(r8),parameter :: psi_r0(nbands) = (/ 5.65308452E-01_r8, -7.30087891E+01_r8/)
3313 real(r8),parameter :: psi_r1(nbands) = (/ 4.07519005E-03_r8, 1.22199547E+00_r8/)
3314 real(r8),parameter :: psi_r2(nbands) = (/-1.04347237E-05_r8, -7.12256227E-03_r8/)
3315 real(r8),parameter :: psi_r3(nbands) = (/ 1.23765354E-08_r8, 1.47852825E-05_r8/)
3316
3317 psi = (((psi_r3(iband) * tpx) + psi_r2(iband)) * tpx + psi_r1(iband)) * tpx + psi_r0(iband)
3318
3319end function psi

3323subroutine trcab(ncol , &
3324 k1 ,k2 ,ucfc11 ,ucfc12 ,un2o0 , &
3325 un2o1 ,uch4 ,uco211 ,uco212 ,uco213 , &
3326 uco221 ,uco222 ,uco223 ,bn2o0 ,bn2o1 , &
3327 bch4 ,to3co2 ,pnm ,dw ,pnew , &
3328 s2c ,uptype ,dplh2o ,abplnk1 ,tco2 , &
3329 th2o ,to3 ,abstrc , &
3330 aer_trn_ttl)
3331!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3332!
3333! Purpose:
3334! Calculate absorptivity for non nearest layers for CH4, N2O, CFC11 and
3335! CFC12.
3336!
3337! Method:
3338! See CCM3 description for equations.
3339!
3340! Author: J. Kiehl
3341!
3342!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3343
3344!------------------------------Arguments--------------------------------
3345!
3346! Input arguments
3347!
3348 integer, intent(in) :: ncol ! number of atmospheric columns
3349 integer, intent(in) :: k1,k2 ! level indices
3350!
3351 real(r8), intent(in) :: to3co2(pcols) ! pressure weighted temperature
3352 real(r8), intent(in) :: pnm(pcols,pverp) ! interface pressures
3353 real(r8), intent(in) :: ucfc11(pcols,pverp) ! CFC11 path length
3354 real(r8), intent(in) :: ucfc12(pcols,pverp) ! CFC12 path length
3355 real(r8), intent(in) :: un2o0(pcols,pverp) ! N2O path length
3356!
3357 real(r8), intent(in) :: un2o1(pcols,pverp) ! N2O path length (hot band)
3358 real(r8), intent(in) :: uch4(pcols,pverp) ! CH4 path length
3359 real(r8), intent(in) :: uco211(pcols,pverp) ! CO2 9.4 micron band path length
3360 real(r8), intent(in) :: uco212(pcols,pverp) ! CO2 9.4 micron band path length
3361 real(r8), intent(in) :: uco213(pcols,pverp) ! CO2 9.4 micron band path length
3362!
3363 real(r8), intent(in) :: uco221(pcols,pverp) ! CO2 10.4 micron band path length
3364 real(r8), intent(in) :: uco222(pcols,pverp) ! CO2 10.4 micron band path length
3365 real(r8), intent(in) :: uco223(pcols,pverp) ! CO2 10.4 micron band path length
3366 real(r8), intent(in) :: bn2o0(pcols,pverp) ! pressure factor for n2o
3367 real(r8), intent(in) :: bn2o1(pcols,pverp) ! pressure factor for n2o
3368!
3369 real(r8), intent(in) :: bch4(pcols,pverp) ! pressure factor for ch4
3370 real(r8), intent(in) :: dw(pcols) ! h2o path length
3371 real(r8), intent(in) :: pnew(pcols) ! pressure
3372 real(r8), intent(in) :: s2c(pcols,pverp) ! continuum path length
3373 real(r8), intent(in) :: uptype(pcols,pverp) ! p-type h2o path length
3374!
3375 real(r8), intent(in) :: dplh2o(pcols) ! p squared h2o path length
3376 real(r8), intent(in) :: abplnk1(14,pcols,pverp) ! Planck factor
3377 real(r8), intent(in) :: tco2(pcols) ! co2 transmission factor
3378 real(r8), intent(in) :: th2o(pcols) ! h2o transmission factor
3379 real(r8), intent(in) :: to3(pcols) ! o3 transmission factor
3380
3381 real(r8), intent(in) :: aer_trn_ttl(pcols,pverp,pverp,nlwbands) ! aer trn.
3382
3383!
3384! Output Arguments
3385!
3386 real(r8), intent(out) :: abstrc(pcols) ! total trace gas absorptivity
3387!
3388!--------------------------Local Variables------------------------------
3389!
3390 integer i,l ! loop counters
3391
3392 real(r8) sqti(pcols) ! square root of mean temp
3393 real(r8) du1 ! cfc11 path length
3394 real(r8) du2 ! cfc12 path length
3395 real(r8) acfc1 ! cfc11 absorptivity 798 cm-1
3396 real(r8) acfc2 ! cfc11 absorptivity 846 cm-1
3397!
3398 real(r8) acfc3 ! cfc11 absorptivity 933 cm-1
3399 real(r8) acfc4 ! cfc11 absorptivity 1085 cm-1
3400 real(r8) acfc5 ! cfc12 absorptivity 889 cm-1
3401 real(r8) acfc6 ! cfc12 absorptivity 923 cm-1
3402 real(r8) acfc7 ! cfc12 absorptivity 1102 cm-1
3403!
3404 real(r8) acfc8 ! cfc12 absorptivity 1161 cm-1
3405 real(r8) du01 ! n2o path length
3406 real(r8) dbeta01 ! n2o pressure factor
3407 real(r8) dbeta11 ! "
3408 real(r8) an2o1 ! absorptivity of 1285 cm-1 n2o band
3409!
3410 real(r8) du02 ! n2o path length
3411 real(r8) dbeta02 ! n2o pressure factor
3412 real(r8) an2o2 ! absorptivity of 589 cm-1 n2o band
3413 real(r8) du03 ! n2o path length
3414 real(r8) dbeta03 ! n2o pressure factor
3415!
3416 real(r8) an2o3 ! absorptivity of 1168 cm-1 n2o band
3417 real(r8) duch4 ! ch4 path length
3418 real(r8) dbetac ! ch4 pressure factor
3419 real(r8) ach4 ! absorptivity of 1306 cm-1 ch4 band
3420 real(r8) du11 ! co2 path length
3421!
3422 real(r8) du12 ! "
3423 real(r8) du13 ! "
3424 real(r8) dbetc1 ! co2 pressure factor
3425 real(r8) dbetc2 ! co2 pressure factor
3426 real(r8) aco21 ! absorptivity of 1064 cm-1 band
3427!
3428 real(r8) du21 ! co2 path length
3429 real(r8) du22 ! "
3430 real(r8) du23 ! "
3431 real(r8) aco22 ! absorptivity of 961 cm-1 band
3432 real(r8) tt(pcols) ! temp. factor for h2o overlap factor
3433!
3434 real(r8) psi1 ! "
3435 real(r8) phi1 ! "
3436 real(r8) p1 ! h2o overlap factor
3437 real(r8) w1 ! "
3438 real(r8) ds2c(pcols) ! continuum path length
3439!
3440 real(r8) duptyp(pcols) ! p-type path length
3441 real(r8) tw(pcols,6) ! h2o transmission factor
3442! real(r8) g1(6) ! "
3443! real(r8) g2(6) ! "
3444! real(r8) g3(6) ! "
3445!
3446! real(r8) g4(6) ! "
3447! real(r8) ab(6) ! h2o temp. factor
3448! real(r8) bb(6) ! "
3449! real(r8) abp(6) ! "
3450! real(r8) bbp(6) ! "
3451!
3452 real(r8) tcfc3 ! transmission for cfc11 band
3453 real(r8) tcfc4 ! transmission for cfc11 band
3454 real(r8) tcfc6 ! transmission for cfc12 band
3455 real(r8) tcfc7 ! transmission for cfc12 band
3456 real(r8) tcfc8 ! transmission for cfc12 band
3457!
3458 real(r8) tlw ! h2o transmission
3459 real(r8) tch4 ! ch4 transmission
3460!
3461!--------------------------Data Statements------------------------------
3462!
3463! data g1 /0.0468556_r8,0.0397454_r8,0.0407664_r8,0.0304380_r8,0.0540398_r8,0.0321962_r8/
3464! data g2 /14.4832_r8,4.30242_r8,5.23523_r8,3.25342_r8,0.698935_r8,16.5599_r8/
3465! data g3 /26.1898_r8,18.4476_r8,15.3633_r8,12.1927_r8,9.14992_r8,8.07092_r8/
3466! data g4 /0.0261782_r8,0.0369516_r8,0.0307266_r8,0.0243854_r8,0.0182932_r8,0.0161418_r8/
3467! data ab /3.0857e-2_r8,2.3524e-2_r8,1.7310e-2_r8,2.6661e-2_r8,2.8074e-2_r8,2.2915e-2_r8/
3468! data bb /-1.3512e-4_r8,-6.8320e-5_r8,-3.2609e-5_r8,-1.0228e-5_r8,-9.5743e-5_r8,-1.0304e-4_r8/
3469! data abp/2.9129e-2_r8,2.4101e-2_r8,1.9821e-2_r8,2.6904e-2_r8,2.9458e-2_r8,1.9892e-2_r8/
3470! data bbp/-1.3139e-4_r8,-5.5688e-5_r8,-4.6380e-5_r8,-8.0362e-5_r8,-1.0115e-4_r8,-8.8061e-5_r8/
3471!
3472!--------------------------Statement Functions--------------------------
3473!
3474 real(r8) func, u, b
3475 func(u,b) = u/sqrt(4.0_r8 + u*(1.0_r8 + 1.0_r8 / b))
3476!
3477!------------------------------------------------------------------------
3478!
3479 do i = 1,ncol
3480 sqti(i) = sqrt(to3co2(i))
3481!
3482! h2o transmission
3483!
3484 tt(i) = abs(to3co2(i) - 250.0_r8)
3485 ds2c(i) = abs(s2c(i,k1) - s2c(i,k2))
3486 duptyp(i) = abs(uptype(i,k1) - uptype(i,k2))
3487 end do
3488!
3489 do l = 1,6
3490 do i = 1,ncol
3491 psi1 = exp(abp(l)*tt(i) + bbp(l)*tt(i)*tt(i))
3492 phi1 = exp(ab(l)*tt(i) + bb(l)*tt(i)*tt(i))
3493 p1 = pnew(i)*(psi1/phi1)/sslp
3494 w1 = dw(i)*phi1
3495 tw(i,l) = exp(-g1(l)*p1*(sqrt(1.0_r8 + g2(l)*(w1/p1)) - 1.0_r8) - &
3496 g3(l)*ds2c(i)-g4(l)*duptyp(i))
3497 end do
3498 end do
3499!
3500 do i=1,ncol
3501 tw(i,1)=tw(i,1)*(0.7_r8*aer_trn_ttl(i,k1,k2,idx_LW_0650_0800)+&! l=1: 0750--0820 cm-1
3502 0.3_r8*aer_trn_ttl(i,k1,k2,idx_LW_0800_1000))
3503 tw(i,2)=tw(i,2)*aer_trn_ttl(i,k1,k2,idx_LW_0800_1000) ! l=2: 0820--0880 cm-1
3504 tw(i,3)=tw(i,3)*aer_trn_ttl(i,k1,k2,idx_LW_0800_1000) ! l=3: 0880--0900 cm-1
3505 tw(i,4)=tw(i,4)*aer_trn_ttl(i,k1,k2,idx_LW_0800_1000) ! l=4: 0900--1000 cm-1
3506 tw(i,5)=tw(i,5)*aer_trn_ttl(i,k1,k2,idx_LW_1000_1200) ! l=5: 1000--1120 cm-1
3507 tw(i,6)=tw(i,6)*aer_trn_ttl(i,k1,k2,idx_LW_1000_1200) ! l=6: 1120--1170 cm-1
3508 end do ! end loop over lon
3509 do i = 1,ncol
3510 du1 = abs(ucfc11(i,k1) - ucfc11(i,k2))
3511 du2 = abs(ucfc12(i,k1) - ucfc12(i,k2))
3512!
3513! cfc transmissions
3514!
3515 tcfc3 = exp(-175.005_r8*du1)
3516 tcfc4 = exp(-1202.18_r8*du1)
3517 tcfc6 = exp(-5786.73_r8*du2)
3518 tcfc7 = exp(-2873.51_r8*du2)
3519 tcfc8 = exp(-2085.59_r8*du2)
3520!
3521! Absorptivity for CFC11 bands
3522!
3523 acfc1 = 50.0_r8*(1.0_r8 - exp(-54.09_r8*du1))*tw(i,1)*abplnk1(7,i,k2)
3524 acfc2 = 60.0_r8*(1.0_r8 - exp(-5130.03_r8*du1))*tw(i,2)*abplnk1(8,i,k2)
3525 acfc3 = 60.0_r8*(1.0_r8 - tcfc3)*tw(i,4)*tcfc6*abplnk1(9,i,k2)
3526 acfc4 = 100.0_r8*(1.0_r8 - tcfc4)*tw(i,5)*abplnk1(10,i,k2)
3527!
3528! Absorptivity for CFC12 bands
3529!
3530 acfc5 = 45.0_r8*(1.0_r8 - exp(-1272.35_r8*du2))*tw(i,3)*abplnk1(11,i,k2)
3531 acfc6 = 50.0_r8*(1.0_r8 - tcfc6)* tw(i,4) * abplnk1(12,i,k2)
3532 acfc7 = 80.0_r8*(1.0_r8 - tcfc7)* tw(i,5) * tcfc4*abplnk1(13,i,k2)
3533 acfc8 = 70.0_r8*(1.0_r8 - tcfc8)* tw(i,6) * abplnk1(14,i,k2)
3534!
3535! Emissivity for CH4 band 1306 cm-1
3536!
3537 tlw = exp(-1.0_r8*sqrt(dplh2o(i)))
3538 tlw=tlw*aer_trn_ttl(i,k1,k2,idx_LW_1200_2000)
3539 duch4 = abs(uch4(i,k1) - uch4(i,k2))
3540 dbetac = abs(bch4(i,k1) - bch4(i,k2))/duch4
3541 ach4 = 6.00444_r8*sqti(i)*log(1.0_r8 + func(duch4,dbetac))*tlw*abplnk1(3,i,k2)
3542 tch4 = 1.0_r8/(1.0_r8 + 0.02_r8*func(duch4,dbetac))
3543!
3544! Absorptivity for N2O bands
3545!
3546 du01 = abs(un2o0(i,k1) - un2o0(i,k2))
3547 du11 = abs(un2o1(i,k1) - un2o1(i,k2))
3548 dbeta01 = abs(bn2o0(i,k1) - bn2o0(i,k2))/du01
3549 dbeta11 = abs(bn2o1(i,k1) - bn2o1(i,k2))/du11
3550!
3551! 1285 cm-1 band
3552!
3553 an2o1 = 2.35558_r8*sqti(i)*log(1.0_r8 + func(du01,dbeta01) &
3554 + func(du11,dbeta11))*tlw*tch4*abplnk1(4,i,k2)
3555 du02 = 0.100090_r8*du01
3556 du12 = 0.0992746_r8*du11
3557 dbeta02 = 0.964282_r8*dbeta01
3558!
3559! 589 cm-1 band
3560!
3561 an2o2 = 2.65581_r8*sqti(i)*log(1.0_r8 + func(du02,dbeta02) + &
3562 func(du12,dbeta02))*th2o(i)*tco2(i)*abplnk1(5,i,k2)
3563 du03 = 0.0333767_r8*du01
3564 dbeta03 = 0.982143_r8*dbeta01
3565!
3566! 1168 cm-1 band
3567!
3568 an2o3 = 2.54034_r8*sqti(i)*log(1.0_r8 + func(du03,dbeta03))* &
3569 tw(i,6)*tcfc8*abplnk1(6,i,k2)
3570!
3571! Emissivity for 1064 cm-1 band of CO2
3572!
3573 du11 = abs(uco211(i,k1) - uco211(i,k2))
3574 du12 = abs(uco212(i,k1) - uco212(i,k2))
3575 du13 = abs(uco213(i,k1) - uco213(i,k2))
3576 dbetc1 = 2.97558_r8*abs(pnm(i,k1) + pnm(i,k2))/(2.0_r8*sslp*sqti(i))
3577 dbetc2 = 2.0_r8*dbetc1
3578 aco21 = 3.7571_r8*sqti(i)*log(1.0_r8 + func(du11,dbetc1) &
3579 + func(du12,dbetc2) + func(du13,dbetc2)) &
3580 *to3(i)*tw(i,5)*tcfc4*tcfc7*abplnk1(2,i,k2)
3581!
3582! Emissivity for 961 cm-1 band
3583!
3584 du21 = abs(uco221(i,k1) - uco221(i,k2))
3585 du22 = abs(uco222(i,k1) - uco222(i,k2))
3586 du23 = abs(uco223(i,k1) - uco223(i,k2))
3587 aco22 = 3.8443_r8*sqti(i)*log(1.0_r8 + func(du21,dbetc1) &
3588 + func(du22,dbetc1) + func(du23,dbetc2)) &
3589 *tw(i,4)*tcfc3*tcfc6*abplnk1(1,i,k2)
3590!
3591! total trace gas absorptivity
3592!
3593 abstrc(i) = acfc1 + acfc2 + acfc3 + acfc4 + acfc5 + acfc6 + &
3594 acfc7 + acfc8 + an2o1 + an2o2 + an2o3 + ach4 + &
3595 aco21 + aco22
3596 end do
3597
3598end subroutine trcab
3599
3600!====================================================================================
3601
3602subroutine trcabn(ncol , &
3603 k2 ,kn ,ucfc11 ,ucfc12 ,un2o0 , &
3604 un2o1 ,uch4 ,uco211 ,uco212 ,uco213 , &
3605 uco221 ,uco222 ,uco223 ,tbar ,bplnk , &
3606 winpl ,pinpl ,tco2 ,th2o ,to3 , &
3607 uptype ,dw ,s2c ,up2 ,pnew , &
3608 abstrc ,uinpl , &
3609 aer_trn_ngh)
3610!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3611!
3612! Purpose:
3613! Calculate nearest layer absorptivity due to CH4, N2O, CFC11 and CFC12
3614!
3615! Method:
3616! Equations in CCM3 description
3617!
3618! Author: J. Kiehl
3619!
3620!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3621
3622!------------------------------Arguments--------------------------------
3623!
3624! Input arguments
3625!
3626 integer, intent(in) :: ncol ! number of atmospheric columns
3627 integer, intent(in) :: k2 ! level index
3628 integer, intent(in) :: kn ! level index
3629!
3630 real(r8), intent(in) :: tbar(pcols,4) ! pressure weighted temperature
3631 real(r8), intent(in) :: ucfc11(pcols,pverp) ! CFC11 path length
3632 real(r8), intent(in) :: ucfc12(pcols,pverp) ! CFC12 path length
3633 real(r8), intent(in) :: un2o0(pcols,pverp) ! N2O path length
3634 real(r8), intent(in) :: un2o1(pcols,pverp) ! N2O path length (hot band)
3635!
3636 real(r8), intent(in) :: uch4(pcols,pverp) ! CH4 path length
3637 real(r8), intent(in) :: uco211(pcols,pverp) ! CO2 9.4 micron band path length
3638 real(r8), intent(in) :: uco212(pcols,pverp) ! CO2 9.4 micron band path length
3639 real(r8), intent(in) :: uco213(pcols,pverp) ! CO2 9.4 micron band path length
3640 real(r8), intent(in) :: uco221(pcols,pverp) ! CO2 10.4 micron band path length
3641!
3642 real(r8), intent(in) :: uco222(pcols,pverp) ! CO2 10.4 micron band path length
3643 real(r8), intent(in) :: uco223(pcols,pverp) ! CO2 10.4 micron band path length
3644 real(r8), intent(in) :: bplnk(14,pcols,4) ! weighted Planck fnc. for absorptivity
3645 real(r8), intent(in) :: winpl(pcols,4) ! fractional path length
3646 real(r8), intent(in) :: pinpl(pcols,4) ! pressure factor for subdivided layer
3647!
3648 real(r8), intent(in) :: tco2(pcols) ! co2 transmission
3649 real(r8), intent(in) :: th2o(pcols) ! h2o transmission
3650 real(r8), intent(in) :: to3(pcols) ! o3 transmission
3651 real(r8), intent(in) :: dw(pcols) ! h2o path length
3652 real(r8), intent(in) :: pnew(pcols) ! pressure factor
3653!
3654 real(r8), intent(in) :: s2c(pcols,pverp) ! h2o continuum factor
3655 real(r8), intent(in) :: uptype(pcols,pverp) ! p-type path length
3656 real(r8), intent(in) :: up2(pcols) ! p squared path length
3657 real(r8), intent(in) :: uinpl(pcols,4) ! Nearest layer subdivision factor
3658 real(r8), intent(in) :: aer_trn_ngh(pcols,nlwbands)
3659 ! [fraction] Total transmission between
3660 ! nearest neighbor sub-levels
3661!
3662! Output Arguments
3663!
3664 real(r8), intent(out) :: abstrc(pcols) ! total trace gas absorptivity
3665
3666!
3667!--------------------------Local Variables------------------------------
3668!
3669 integer i,l ! loop counters
3670!
3671 real(r8) sqti(pcols) ! square root of mean temp
3672 real(r8) rsqti(pcols) ! reciprocal of sqti
3673 real(r8) du1 ! cfc11 path length
3674 real(r8) du2 ! cfc12 path length
3675 real(r8) acfc1 ! absorptivity of cfc11 798 cm-1 band
3676!
3677 real(r8) acfc2 ! absorptivity of cfc11 846 cm-1 band
3678 real(r8) acfc3 ! absorptivity of cfc11 933 cm-1 band
3679 real(r8) acfc4 ! absorptivity of cfc11 1085 cm-1 band
3680 real(r8) acfc5 ! absorptivity of cfc11 889 cm-1 band
3681 real(r8) acfc6 ! absorptivity of cfc11 923 cm-1 band
3682!
3683 real(r8) acfc7 ! absorptivity of cfc11 1102 cm-1 band
3684 real(r8) acfc8 ! absorptivity of cfc11 1161 cm-1 band
3685 real(r8) du01 ! n2o path length
3686 real(r8) dbeta01 ! n2o pressure factors
3687 real(r8) dbeta11 ! "
3688!
3689 real(r8) an2o1 ! absorptivity of the 1285 cm-1 n2o band
3690 real(r8) du02 ! n2o path length
3691 real(r8) dbeta02 ! n2o pressure factor
3692 real(r8) an2o2 ! absorptivity of the 589 cm-1 n2o band
3693 real(r8) du03 ! n2o path length
3694!
3695 real(r8) dbeta03 ! n2o pressure factor
3696 real(r8) an2o3 ! absorptivity of the 1168 cm-1 n2o band
3697 real(r8) duch4 ! ch4 path length
3698 real(r8) dbetac ! ch4 pressure factor
3699 real(r8) ach4 ! absorptivity of the 1306 cm-1 ch4 band
3700!
3701 real(r8) du11 ! co2 path length
3702 real(r8) du12 ! "
3703 real(r8) du13 ! "
3704 real(r8) dbetc1 ! co2 pressure factor
3705 real(r8) dbetc2 ! co2 pressure factor
3706!
3707 real(r8) aco21 ! absorptivity of the 1064 cm-1 co2 band
3708 real(r8) du21 ! co2 path length
3709 real(r8) du22 ! "
3710 real(r8) du23 ! "
3711 real(r8) aco22 ! absorptivity of the 961 cm-1 co2 band
3712!
3713 real(r8) tt(pcols) ! temp. factor for h2o overlap
3714 real(r8) psi1 ! "
3715 real(r8) phi1 ! "
3716 real(r8) p1 ! factor for h2o overlap
3717 real(r8) w1 ! "
3718!
3719 real(r8) ds2c(pcols) ! continuum path length
3720 real(r8) duptyp(pcols) ! p-type path length
3721 real(r8) tw(pcols,6) ! h2o transmission overlap
3722! real(r8) g1(6) ! h2o overlap factor
3723! real(r8) g2(6) ! "
3724!
3725! real(r8) g3(6) ! "
3726! real(r8) g4(6) ! "
3727! real(r8) ab(6) ! h2o temp. factor
3728! real(r8) bb(6) ! "
3729! real(r8) abp(6) ! "
3730!
3731! real(r8) bbp(6) ! "
3732 real(r8) tcfc3 ! transmission of cfc11 band
3733 real(r8) tcfc4 ! transmission of cfc11 band
3734 real(r8) tcfc6 ! transmission of cfc12 band
3735 real(r8) tcfc7 ! "
3736!
3737 real(r8) tcfc8 ! "
3738 real(r8) tlw ! h2o transmission
3739 real(r8) tch4 ! ch4 transmission
3740!
3741!--------------------------Data Statements------------------------------
3742!
3743! data g1 /0.0468556_r8,0.0397454_r8,0.0407664_r8,0.0304380_r8,0.0540398_r8,0.0321962_r8/
3744! data g2 /14.4832_r8,4.30242_r8,5.23523_r8,3.25342_r8,0.698935_r8,16.5599_r8/
3745! data g3 /26.1898_r8,18.4476_r8,15.3633_r8,12.1927_r8,9.14992_r8,8.07092_r8/
3746! data g4 /0.0261782_r8,0.0369516_r8,0.0307266_r8,0.0243854_r8,0.0182932_r8,0.0161418_r8/
3747! data ab /3.0857e-2_r8,2.3524e-2_r8,1.7310e-2_r8,2.6661e-2_r8,2.8074e-2_r8,2.2915e-2_r8/
3748! data bb /-1.3512e-4_r8,-6.8320e-5_r8,-3.2609e-5_r8,-1.0228e-5_r8,-9.5743e-5_r8,-1.0304e-4_r8/
3749! data abp/2.9129e-2_r8,2.4101e-2_r8,1.9821e-2_r8,2.6904e-2_r8,2.9458e-2_r8,1.9892e-2_r8/
3750! data bbp/-1.3139e-4_r8,-5.5688e-5_r8,-4.6380e-5_r8,-8.0362e-5_r8,-1.0115e-4_r8,-8.8061e-5_r8/
3751!
3752!--------------------------Statement Functions--------------------------
3753!
3754 real(r8) func, u, b
3755 func(u,b) = u/sqrt(4.0_r8 + u*(1.0_r8 + 1.0_r8 / b))
3756!
3757!------------------------------------------------------------------
3758!
3759 do i = 1,ncol
3760 sqti(i) = sqrt(tbar(i,kn))
3761 rsqti(i) = 1._r8 / sqti(i)
3762!
3763! h2o transmission
3764!
3765 tt(i) = abs(tbar(i,kn) - 250.0_r8)
3766 ds2c(i) = abs(s2c(i,k2+1) - s2c(i,k2))*uinpl(i,kn)
3767 duptyp(i) = abs(uptype(i,k2+1) - uptype(i,k2))*uinpl(i,kn)
3768 end do
3769!
3770 do l = 1,6
3771 do i = 1,ncol
3772 psi1 = exp(abp(l)*tt(i)+bbp(l)*tt(i)*tt(i))
3773 phi1 = exp(ab(l)*tt(i)+bb(l)*tt(i)*tt(i))
3774 p1 = pnew(i) * (psi1/phi1) / sslp
3775 w1 = dw(i) * winpl(i,kn) * phi1
3776 tw(i,l) = exp(- g1(l)*p1*(sqrt(1.0_r8+g2(l)*(w1/p1))-1.0_r8) &
3777 - g3(l)*ds2c(i)-g4(l)*duptyp(i))
3778 end do
3779 end do
3780!
3781 do i=1,ncol
3782 tw(i,1)=tw(i,1)*(0.7_r8*aer_trn_ngh(i,idx_LW_0650_0800)+&! l=1: 0750--0820 cm-1
3783 0.3_r8*aer_trn_ngh(i,idx_LW_0800_1000))
3784 tw(i,2)=tw(i,2)*aer_trn_ngh(i,idx_LW_0800_1000) ! l=2: 0820--0880 cm-1
3785 tw(i,3)=tw(i,3)*aer_trn_ngh(i,idx_LW_0800_1000) ! l=3: 0880--0900 cm-1
3786 tw(i,4)=tw(i,4)*aer_trn_ngh(i,idx_LW_0800_1000) ! l=4: 0900--1000 cm-1
3787 tw(i,5)=tw(i,5)*aer_trn_ngh(i,idx_LW_1000_1200) ! l=5: 1000--1120 cm-1
3788 tw(i,6)=tw(i,6)*aer_trn_ngh(i,idx_LW_1000_1200) ! l=6: 1120--1170 cm-1
3789 end do ! end loop over lon
3790
3791 do i = 1,ncol
3792!
3793 du1 = abs(ucfc11(i,k2+1) - ucfc11(i,k2)) * winpl(i,kn)
3794 du2 = abs(ucfc12(i,k2+1) - ucfc12(i,k2)) * winpl(i,kn)
3795!
3796! cfc transmissions
3797!
3798 tcfc3 = exp(-175.005_r8*du1)
3799 tcfc4 = exp(-1202.18_r8*du1)
3800 tcfc6 = exp(-5786.73_r8*du2)
3801 tcfc7 = exp(-2873.51_r8*du2)
3802 tcfc8 = exp(-2085.59_r8*du2)
3803!
3804! Absorptivity for CFC11 bands
3805!
3806 acfc1 = 50.0_r8*(1.0_r8 - exp(-54.09_r8*du1)) * tw(i,1)*bplnk(7,i,kn)
3807 acfc2 = 60.0_r8*(1.0_r8 - exp(-5130.03_r8*du1))*tw(i,2)*bplnk(8,i,kn)
3808 acfc3 = 60.0_r8*(1.0_r8 - tcfc3)*tw(i,4)*tcfc6 * bplnk(9,i,kn)
3809 acfc4 = 100.0_r8*(1.0_r8 - tcfc4)* tw(i,5) * bplnk(10,i,kn)
3810!
3811! Absorptivity for CFC12 bands
3812!
3813 acfc5 = 45.0_r8*(1.0_r8 - exp(-1272.35_r8*du2))*tw(i,3)*bplnk(11,i,kn)
3814 acfc6 = 50.0_r8*(1.0_r8 - tcfc6)*tw(i,4)*bplnk(12,i,kn)
3815 acfc7 = 80.0_r8*(1.0_r8 - tcfc7)* tw(i,5)*tcfc4 *bplnk(13,i,kn)
3816 acfc8 = 70.0_r8*(1.0_r8 - tcfc8)*tw(i,6)*bplnk(14,i,kn)
3817!
3818! Absorptivity for CH4 band 1306 cm-1
3819!
3820 tlw = exp(-1.0_r8*sqrt(up2(i)))
3821 tlw=tlw*aer_trn_ngh(i,idx_LW_1200_2000)
3822 duch4 = abs(uch4(i,k2+1) - uch4(i,k2)) * winpl(i,kn)
3823 dbetac = 2.94449_r8 * pinpl(i,kn) * rsqti(i) / sslp
3824 ach4 = 6.00444_r8*sqti(i)*log(1.0_r8 + func(duch4,dbetac)) * tlw * bplnk(3,i,kn)
3825 tch4 = 1.0_r8/(1.0_r8 + 0.02_r8*func(duch4,dbetac))
3826!
3827! Absorptivity for N2O bands
3828!
3829 du01 = abs(un2o0(i,k2+1) - un2o0(i,k2)) * winpl(i,kn)
3830 du11 = abs(un2o1(i,k2+1) - un2o1(i,k2)) * winpl(i,kn)
3831 dbeta01 = 19.399_r8 * pinpl(i,kn) * rsqti(i) / sslp
3832 dbeta11 = dbeta01
3833!
3834! 1285 cm-1 band
3835!
3836 an2o1 = 2.35558_r8*sqti(i)*log(1.0_r8 + func(du01,dbeta01) &
3837 + func(du11,dbeta11)) * tlw * tch4 * bplnk(4,i,kn)
3838 du02 = 0.100090_r8*du01
3839 du12 = 0.0992746_r8*du11
3840 dbeta02 = 0.964282_r8*dbeta01
3841!
3842! 589 cm-1 band
3843!
3844 an2o2 = 2.65581_r8*sqti(i)*log(1.0_r8 + func(du02,dbeta02) &
3845 + func(du12,dbeta02)) * tco2(i) * th2o(i) * bplnk(5,i,kn)
3846 du03 = 0.0333767_r8*du01
3847 dbeta03 = 0.982143_r8*dbeta01
3848!
3849! 1168 cm-1 band
3850!
3851 an2o3 = 2.54034_r8*sqti(i)*log(1.0_r8 + func(du03,dbeta03)) * &
3852 tw(i,6) * tcfc8 * bplnk(6,i,kn)
3853!
3854! Absorptivity for 1064 cm-1 band of CO2
3855!
3856 du11 = abs(uco211(i,k2+1) - uco211(i,k2)) * winpl(i,kn)
3857 du12 = abs(uco212(i,k2+1) - uco212(i,k2)) * winpl(i,kn)
3858 du13 = abs(uco213(i,k2+1) - uco213(i,k2)) * winpl(i,kn)
3859 dbetc1 = 2.97558_r8 * pinpl(i,kn) * rsqti(i) / sslp
3860 dbetc2 = 2.0_r8 * dbetc1
3861 aco21 = 3.7571_r8*sqti(i)*log(1.0_r8 + func(du11,dbetc1) &
3862 + func(du12,dbetc2) + func(du13,dbetc2)) &
3863 * to3(i) * tw(i,5) * tcfc4 * tcfc7 * bplnk(2,i,kn)
3864!
3865! Absorptivity for 961 cm-1 band of co2
3866!
3867 du21 = abs(uco221(i,k2+1) - uco221(i,k2)) * winpl(i,kn)
3868 du22 = abs(uco222(i,k2+1) - uco222(i,k2)) * winpl(i,kn)
3869 du23 = abs(uco223(i,k2+1) - uco223(i,k2)) * winpl(i,kn)
3870 aco22 = 3.8443_r8*sqti(i)*log(1.0_r8 + func(du21,dbetc1) &
3871 + func(du22,dbetc1) + func(du23,dbetc2)) &
3872 * tw(i,4) * tcfc3 * tcfc6 * bplnk(1,i,kn)
3873!
3874! total trace gas absorptivity
3875!
3876 abstrc(i) = acfc1 + acfc2 + acfc3 + acfc4 + acfc5 + acfc6 + &
3877 acfc7 + acfc8 + an2o1 + an2o2 + an2o3 + ach4 + &
3878 aco21 + aco22
3879 end do
3880
3881end subroutine trcabn
3882
3883!====================================================================================
3884
3885subroutine trcems(ncol , &
3886 k ,co2t ,pnm ,ucfc11 ,ucfc12 , &
3887 un2o0 ,un2o1 ,bn2o0 ,bn2o1 ,uch4 , &
3888 bch4 ,uco211 ,uco212 ,uco213 ,uco221 , &
3889 uco222 ,uco223 ,uptype ,w ,s2c , &
3890 up2 ,emplnk ,th2o ,tco2 ,to3 , &
3891 emstrc , &
3892 aer_trn_ttl)
3893!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3894!
3895! Purpose:
3896! Calculate emissivity for CH4, N2O, CFC11 and CFC12 bands.
3897!
3898! Method:
3899! See CCM3 Description for equations.
3900!
3901! Author: J. Kiehl
3902!
3903!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3904
3905!------------------------------Arguments--------------------------------
3906!
3907! Input arguments
3908!
3909 integer, intent(in) :: ncol ! number of atmospheric columns
3910
3911 real(r8), intent(in) :: co2t(pcols,pverp) ! pressure weighted temperature
3912 real(r8), intent(in) :: pnm(pcols,pverp) ! interface pressure
3913 real(r8), intent(in) :: ucfc11(pcols,pverp) ! CFC11 path length
3914 real(r8), intent(in) :: ucfc12(pcols,pverp) ! CFC12 path length
3915 real(r8), intent(in) :: un2o0(pcols,pverp) ! N2O path length
3916!
3917 real(r8), intent(in) :: un2o1(pcols,pverp) ! N2O path length (hot band)
3918 real(r8), intent(in) :: uch4(pcols,pverp) ! CH4 path length
3919 real(r8), intent(in) :: uco211(pcols,pverp) ! CO2 9.4 micron band path length
3920 real(r8), intent(in) :: uco212(pcols,pverp) ! CO2 9.4 micron band path length
3921 real(r8), intent(in) :: uco213(pcols,pverp) ! CO2 9.4 micron band path length
3922!
3923 real(r8), intent(in) :: uco221(pcols,pverp) ! CO2 10.4 micron band path length
3924 real(r8), intent(in) :: uco222(pcols,pverp) ! CO2 10.4 micron band path length
3925 real(r8), intent(in) :: uco223(pcols,pverp) ! CO2 10.4 micron band path length
3926 real(r8), intent(in) :: uptype(pcols,pverp) ! continuum path length
3927 real(r8), intent(in) :: bn2o0(pcols,pverp) ! pressure factor for n2o
3928!
3929 real(r8), intent(in) :: bn2o1(pcols,pverp) ! pressure factor for n2o
3930 real(r8), intent(in) :: bch4(pcols,pverp) ! pressure factor for ch4
3931 real(r8), intent(in) :: emplnk(14,pcols) ! emissivity Planck factor
3932 real(r8), intent(in) :: th2o(pcols) ! water vapor overlap factor
3933 real(r8), intent(in) :: tco2(pcols) ! co2 overlap factor
3934!
3935 real(r8), intent(in) :: to3(pcols) ! o3 overlap factor
3936 real(r8), intent(in) :: s2c(pcols,pverp) ! h2o continuum path length
3937 real(r8), intent(in) :: w(pcols,pverp) ! h2o path length
3938 real(r8), intent(in) :: up2(pcols) ! pressure squared h2o path length
3939!
3940 integer, intent(in) :: k ! level index
3941
3942 real(r8), intent(in) :: aer_trn_ttl(pcols,pverp,pverp,nlwbands) ! aer trn.
3943
3944!
3945! Output Arguments
3946!
3947 real(r8), intent(out) :: emstrc(pcols,pverp) ! total trace gas emissivity
3948
3949!
3950!--------------------------Local Variables------------------------------
3951!
3952 integer i,l ! loop counters
3953!
3954 real(r8) sqti(pcols) ! square root of mean temp
3955 real(r8) ecfc1 ! emissivity of cfc11 798 cm-1 band
3956 real(r8) ecfc2 ! " " " 846 cm-1 band
3957 real(r8) ecfc3 ! " " " 933 cm-1 band
3958 real(r8) ecfc4 ! " " " 1085 cm-1 band
3959!
3960 real(r8) ecfc5 ! " " cfc12 889 cm-1 band
3961 real(r8) ecfc6 ! " " " 923 cm-1 band
3962 real(r8) ecfc7 ! " " " 1102 cm-1 band
3963 real(r8) ecfc8 ! " " " 1161 cm-1 band
3964 real(r8) u01 ! n2o path length
3965!
3966 real(r8) u11 ! n2o path length
3967 real(r8) beta01 ! n2o pressure factor
3968 real(r8) beta11 ! n2o pressure factor
3969 real(r8) en2o1 ! emissivity of the 1285 cm-1 N2O band
3970 real(r8) u02 ! n2o path length
3971!
3972 real(r8) u12 ! n2o path length
3973 real(r8) beta02 ! n2o pressure factor
3974 real(r8) en2o2 ! emissivity of the 589 cm-1 N2O band
3975 real(r8) u03 ! n2o path length
3976 real(r8) beta03 ! n2o pressure factor
3977!
3978 real(r8) en2o3 ! emissivity of the 1168 cm-1 N2O band
3979 real(r8) betac ! ch4 pressure factor
3980 real(r8) ech4 ! emissivity of 1306 cm-1 CH4 band
3981 real(r8) betac1 ! co2 pressure factor
3982 real(r8) betac2 ! co2 pressure factor
3983!
3984 real(r8) eco21 ! emissivity of 1064 cm-1 CO2 band
3985 real(r8) eco22 ! emissivity of 961 cm-1 CO2 band
3986 real(r8) tt(pcols) ! temp. factor for h2o overlap factor
3987 real(r8) psi1 ! narrow band h2o temp. factor
3988 real(r8) phi1 ! "
3989!
3990 real(r8) p1 ! h2o line overlap factor
3991 real(r8) w1 ! "
3992 real(r8) tw(pcols,6) ! h2o transmission overlap
3993! real(r8) g1(6) ! h2o overlap factor
3994! real(r8) g2(6) ! "
3995!
3996! real(r8) g3(6) ! "
3997! real(r8) g4(6) ! "
3998! real(r8) ab(6) ! "
3999! real(r8) bb(6) ! "
4000! real(r8) abp(6) ! "
4001!
4002! real(r8) bbp(6) ! "
4003 real(r8) tcfc3 ! transmission for cfc11 band
4004 real(r8) tcfc4 ! "
4005 real(r8) tcfc6 ! transmission for cfc12 band
4006 real(r8) tcfc7 ! "
4007!
4008 real(r8) tcfc8 ! "
4009 real(r8) tlw ! h2o overlap factor
4010 real(r8) tch4 ! ch4 overlap factor
4011!
4012!--------------------------Data Statements------------------------------
4013!
4014! data g1 /0.0468556_r8,0.0397454_r8,0.0407664_r8,0.0304380_r8,0.0540398_r8,0.0321962_r8/
4015! data g2 /14.4832_r8,4.30242_r8,5.23523_r8,3.25342_r8,0.698935_r8,16.5599_r8/
4016! data g3 /26.1898_r8,18.4476_r8,15.3633_r8,12.1927_r8,9.14992_r8,8.07092_r8/
4017! data g4 /0.0261782_r8,0.0369516_r8,0.0307266_r8,0.0243854_r8,0.0182932_r8,0.0161418_r8/
4018! data ab /3.0857e-2_r8,2.3524e-2_r8,1.7310e-2_r8,2.6661e-2_r8,2.8074e-2_r8,2.2915e-2_r8/
4019! data bb /-1.3512e-4_r8,-6.8320e-5_r8,-3.2609e-5_r8,-1.0228e-5_r8,-9.5743e-5_r8,-1.0304e-4_r8/
4020! data abp/2.9129e-2_r8,2.4101e-2_r8,1.9821e-2_r8,2.6904e-2_r8,2.9458e-2_r8,1.9892e-2_r8/
4021! data bbp/-1.3139e-4_r8,-5.5688e-5_r8,-4.6380e-5_r8,-8.0362e-5_r8,-1.0115e-4_r8,-8.8061e-5_r8/
4022!
4023!--------------------------Statement Functions--------------------------
4024!
4025 real(r8) func, u, b
4026 func(u,b) = u/sqrt(4.0_r8 + u*(1.0_r8 + 1.0_r8 / b))
4027!
4028!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4029!
4030 do i = 1,ncol
4031 sqti(i) = sqrt(co2t(i,k))
4032!
4033! Transmission for h2o
4034!
4035 tt(i) = abs(co2t(i,k) - 250.0_r8)
4036 end do
4037!
4038 do l = 1,6
4039 do i = 1,ncol
4040 psi1 = exp(abp(l)*tt(i)+bbp(l)*tt(i)*tt(i))
4041 phi1 = exp(ab(l)*tt(i)+bb(l)*tt(i)*tt(i))
4042 p1 = pnm(i,k) * (psi1/phi1) / sslp
4043 w1 = w(i,k) * phi1
4044 tw(i,l) = exp(- g1(l)*p1*(sqrt(1.0_r8+g2(l)*(w1/p1))-1.0_r8) &
4045 - g3(l)*s2c(i,k)-g4(l)*uptype(i,k))
4046 end do
4047 end do
4048
4049! Overlap H2O tranmission with STRAER continuum in 6 trace gas
4050! subbands
4051
4052 do i=1,ncol
4053 tw(i,1)=tw(i,1)*(0.7_r8*aer_trn_ttl(i,k,1,idx_LW_0650_0800)+&! l=1: 0750--0820 cm-1
4054 0.3_r8*aer_trn_ttl(i,k,1,idx_LW_0800_1000))
4055 tw(i,2)=tw(i,2)*aer_trn_ttl(i,k,1,idx_LW_0800_1000) ! l=2: 0820--0880 cm-1
4056 tw(i,3)=tw(i,3)*aer_trn_ttl(i,k,1,idx_LW_0800_1000) ! l=3: 0880--0900 cm-1
4057 tw(i,4)=tw(i,4)*aer_trn_ttl(i,k,1,idx_LW_0800_1000) ! l=4: 0900--1000 cm-1
4058 tw(i,5)=tw(i,5)*aer_trn_ttl(i,k,1,idx_LW_1000_1200) ! l=5: 1000--1120 cm-1
4059 tw(i,6)=tw(i,6)*aer_trn_ttl(i,k,1,idx_LW_1000_1200) ! l=6: 1120--1170 cm-1
4060 end do ! end loop over lon
4061!
4062 do i = 1,ncol
4063!
4064! transmission due to cfc bands
4065!
4066 tcfc3 = exp(-175.005_r8*ucfc11(i,k))
4067 tcfc4 = exp(-1202.18_r8*ucfc11(i,k))
4068 tcfc6 = exp(-5786.73_r8*ucfc12(i,k))
4069 tcfc7 = exp(-2873.51_r8*ucfc12(i,k))
4070 tcfc8 = exp(-2085.59_r8*ucfc12(i,k))
4071!
4072! Emissivity for CFC11 bands
4073!
4074 ecfc1 = 50.0_r8*(1.0_r8 - exp(-54.09_r8*ucfc11(i,k))) * tw(i,1) * emplnk(7,i)
4075 ecfc2 = 60.0_r8*(1.0_r8 - exp(-5130.03_r8*ucfc11(i,k)))* tw(i,2) * emplnk(8,i)
4076 ecfc3 = 60.0_r8*(1.0_r8 - tcfc3)*tw(i,4)*tcfc6*emplnk(9,i)
4077 ecfc4 = 100.0_r8*(1.0_r8 - tcfc4)*tw(i,5)*emplnk(10,i)
4078!
4079! Emissivity for CFC12 bands
4080!
4081 ecfc5 = 45.0_r8*(1.0_r8 - exp(-1272.35_r8*ucfc12(i,k)))*tw(i,3)*emplnk(11,i)
4082 ecfc6 = 50.0_r8*(1.0_r8 - tcfc6)*tw(i,4)*emplnk(12,i)
4083 ecfc7 = 80.0_r8*(1.0_r8 - tcfc7)*tw(i,5)* tcfc4 * emplnk(13,i)
4084 ecfc8 = 70.0_r8*(1.0_r8 - tcfc8)*tw(i,6) * emplnk(14,i)
4085!
4086! Emissivity for CH4 band 1306 cm-1
4087!
4088 tlw = exp(-1.0_r8*sqrt(up2(i)))
4089
4090! Overlap H2O vibration rotation band with STRAER continuum
4091! for CH4 1306 cm-1 and N2O 1285 cm-1 bands
4092
4093 tlw=tlw*aer_trn_ttl(i,k,1,idx_LW_1200_2000)
4094 betac = bch4(i,k)/uch4(i,k)
4095 ech4 = 6.00444_r8*sqti(i)*log(1.0_r8 + func(uch4(i,k),betac)) *tlw * emplnk(3,i)
4096 tch4 = 1.0_r8/(1.0_r8 + 0.02_r8*func(uch4(i,k),betac))
4097!
4098! Emissivity for N2O bands
4099!
4100 u01 = un2o0(i,k)
4101 u11 = un2o1(i,k)
4102 beta01 = bn2o0(i,k)/un2o0(i,k)
4103 beta11 = bn2o1(i,k)/un2o1(i,k)
4104!
4105! 1285 cm-1 band
4106!
4107 en2o1 = 2.35558_r8*sqti(i)*log(1.0_r8 + func(u01,beta01) + &
4108 func(u11,beta11))*tlw*tch4*emplnk(4,i)
4109 u02 = 0.100090_r8*u01
4110 u12 = 0.0992746_r8*u11
4111 beta02 = 0.964282_r8*beta01
4112!
4113! 589 cm-1 band
4114!
4115 en2o2 = 2.65581_r8*sqti(i)*log(1.0_r8 + func(u02,beta02) + &
4116 func(u12,beta02)) * tco2(i) * th2o(i) * emplnk(5,i)
4117 u03 = 0.0333767_r8*u01
4118 beta03 = 0.982143_r8*beta01
4119!
4120! 1168 cm-1 band
4121!
4122 en2o3 = 2.54034_r8*sqti(i)*log(1.0_r8 + func(u03,beta03)) * &
4123 tw(i,6) * tcfc8 * emplnk(6,i)
4124!
4125! Emissivity for 1064 cm-1 band of CO2
4126!
4127 betac1 = 2.97558_r8*pnm(i,k) / (sslp*sqti(i))
4128 betac2 = 2.0_r8 * betac1
4129 eco21 = 3.7571_r8*sqti(i)*log(1.0_r8 + func(uco211(i,k),betac1) &
4130 + func(uco212(i,k),betac2) + func(uco213(i,k),betac2)) &
4131 * to3(i) * tw(i,5) * tcfc4 * tcfc7 * emplnk(2,i)
4132!
4133! Emissivity for 961 cm-1 band
4134!
4135 eco22 = 3.8443_r8*sqti(i)*log(1.0_r8 + func(uco221(i,k),betac1) &
4136 + func(uco222(i,k),betac1) + func(uco223(i,k),betac2)) &
4137 * tw(i,4) * tcfc3 * tcfc6 * emplnk(1,i)
4138!
4139! total trace gas emissivity
4140!
4141 emstrc(i,k) = ecfc1 + ecfc2 + ecfc3 + ecfc4 + ecfc5 +ecfc6 + &
4142 ecfc7 + ecfc8 + en2o1 + en2o2 + en2o3 + ech4 + &
4143 eco21 + eco22
4144 end do
4145
4146end subroutine trcems
4147
4148!====================================================================================
4149
4150subroutine trcplk(ncol , &
4151 tint ,tlayr ,tplnke ,emplnk ,abplnk1 , &
4152 abplnk2 )
4153!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4154!
4155! Purpose:
4156! Calculate Planck factors for absorptivity and emissivity of
4157! CH4, N2O, CFC11 and CFC12
4158!
4159! Method:
4160! Planck function and derivative evaluated at the band center.
4161!
4162! Author: J. Kiehl
4163!
4164!------------------------------Arguments--------------------------------
4165!
4166! Input arguments
4167!
4168 integer, intent(in) :: ncol ! number of atmospheric columns
4169
4170 real(r8), intent(in) :: tint(pcols,pverp) ! interface temperatures
4171 real(r8), intent(in) :: tlayr(pcols,pverp) ! k-1 level temperatures
4172 real(r8), intent(in) :: tplnke(pcols) ! Top Layer temperature
4173!
4174! output arguments
4175!
4176 real(r8), intent(out) :: emplnk(14,pcols) ! emissivity Planck factor
4177 real(r8), intent(out) :: abplnk1(14,pcols,pverp) ! non-nearest layer Plack factor
4178 real(r8), intent(out) :: abplnk2(14,pcols,pverp) ! nearest layer factor
4179
4180!
4181!--------------------------Local Variables------------------------------
4182!
4183 integer wvl ! wavelength index
4184 integer i,k ! loop counters
4185!
4186 real(r8) f1(14) ! Planck function factor
4187 real(r8) f2(14) ! "
4188 real(r8) f3(14) ! "
4189!
4190!--------------------------Data Statements------------------------------
4191!
4192 data f1 /5.85713e8_r8,7.94950e8_r8,1.47009e9_r8,1.40031e9_r8,1.34853e8_r8, &
4193 1.05158e9_r8,3.35370e8_r8,3.99601e8_r8,5.35994e8_r8,8.42955e8_r8, &
4194 4.63682e8_r8,5.18944e8_r8,8.83202e8_r8,1.03279e9_r8/
4195 data f2 /2.02493e11_r8,3.04286e11_r8,6.90698e11_r8,6.47333e11_r8, &
4196 2.85744e10_r8,4.41862e11_r8,9.62780e10_r8,1.21618e11_r8, &
4197 1.79905e11_r8,3.29029e11_r8,1.48294e11_r8,1.72315e11_r8, &
4198 3.50140e11_r8,4.31364e11_r8/
4199 data f3 /1383.0_r8,1531.0_r8,1879.0_r8,1849.0_r8,848.0_r8,1681.0_r8, &
4200 1148.0_r8,1217.0_r8,1343.0_r8,1561.0_r8,1279.0_r8,1328.0_r8, &
4201 1586.0_r8,1671.0_r8/
4202!
4203!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4204!
4205! Calculate emissivity Planck factor
4206!
4207 do wvl = 1,14
4208 do i = 1,ncol
4209 emplnk(wvl,i) = f1(wvl)/(tplnke(i)**4.0_r8*(exp(f3(wvl)/tplnke(i))-1.0_r8))
4210 end do
4211 end do
4212!
4213! Calculate absorptivity Planck factor for tint and tlayr temperatures
4214!
4215 do wvl = 1,14
4216 do k = ntoplw, pverp
4217 do i = 1, ncol
4218!
4219! non-nearlest layer function
4220!
4221 abplnk1(wvl,i,k) = (f2(wvl)*exp(f3(wvl)/tint(i,k))) &
4222 /(tint(i,k)**5.0_r8*(exp(f3(wvl)/tint(i,k))-1.0_r8)**2.0_r8)
4223!
4224! nearest layer function
4225!
4226 abplnk2(wvl,i,k) = (f2(wvl)*exp(f3(wvl)/tlayr(i,k))) &
4227 /(tlayr(i,k)**5.0_r8*(exp(f3(wvl)/tlayr(i,k))-1.0_r8)**2.0_r8)
4228 end do
4229 end do
4230 end do
4231
4232end subroutine trcplk
4233
